raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Variable-length DCP training can select either independent in-tree CPU solver and prepare one future schedule while the current batch trains. Both solvers run on the existing classic CP ProcessGroups/TE path, without a custom native transport build. Candidate widths are supported power-of-two divisors of DP×CP; starts align to each group's width. Search remains enabled, and the baseline-only diagnostic is opt-in.

Includes the lightweight and DynamicUSP solvers, all three cost models and their unchanged parameter/provenance/license assets, a persistent CUDA-hidden CPU worker, sync/async controls and telemetry, logical/physical length gathering, dataloader/rerun/training integration, topology-aware heuristic scheduling over legal classic groups, packaging, docs and tests. Generic planner geometry retains arbitrary-width support; DynamicUSP retains its original aligned power-of-two allocation policy. The temporary upstream U8 all-to-all/ring cost profile is a scheduling proxy, not a native-P2P calibration.

This is the prerequisite split from #6801 and targets `dev` `ff20ed54650dd47ba21989767dfc0068d8c6f73e`. Native transport, logical CP descriptors, functional arbitrary CP, and attention/MoE/MTP/layout changes remain in #6801, which also depends on NVIDIA/TransformerEngine#3420. This PR has no dependency on that TE change. Actual diff: **39 files, +7,218/-58**.

Validation:
- GPU/unit source `b79a0882b5626a72ff3b183850cbc28a1f9d30a8`: DFW **20845120 COMPLETED 0:0**, **341 passed per rank on 8 H100s, zero failures/skips**. Includes both solvers × three models, power-only candidate legality, CP4-at-rank2 rejection, aligned rotations, worker isolation and async/rerun contracts.
- Final head `1bc12aaff511eccd728566fcad47daf4b7043c8d` adds only 55 API docstrings and formatting in 11 files. Every changed executable AST is identical to the GPU-tested source. DFW **20845603 COMPLETED 0:0** rebuilt/loaded both final-source wheels and checked 112 frozen scalar predictions plus 198 legal plans per source, all three models and four parameter assets, with no PyTorch import in the CPU model checks.
- Classic E2E: both solvers' async/sync controls completed four steps per mode on the same 8 H100s. Initial weights, actual inputs, rows, predicted scores, logged LM/sequence-aux loss and grad norm match exactly across each pair. Actual CP: lightweight 2/4/8; DynamicUSP 1/2/4/8. Persistent workers remain CUDA/distributed-free, with recurring plans ready **3/3** in every case.
- DFW training job **20845122** completed all eight classic/native training stages **0:0**; its overall status is **FAILED** because audit-v1 incorrectly required observed GPU compute overlap in every case. CPU audit **20845655 COMPLETED 0:0** checks all four pairs unchanged and reports overlap per case. Lightweight has witnessed compute overlap; the small-batch DynamicUSP cases finish outside the recorded compute kernels and carry no compute-overlap claim.
- The experiment is a four-layer BF16 standard-FA/MoE MockVarlenDataset proxy: hidden 512, Q32/KV4/head128, TP1/PP1/EP4, GBS16. The frozen GB200 attention profile is used provisionally on H100; this is not a latency-accuracy or throughput result.
- Full repository formatting/lint checks with `SKIP_DOCS=false`, kernel-determinism coverage and GitHub lint passed. Full GitHub CI is still running and is not claimed as passing.

The historical Qwen3-30B-A3B/LongAlign 100-step fixed-CP accuracy gate remains **OPEN**; same-solver sync/async agreement does not close it. No coefficients or tolerances were retuned.

Keep this PR draft. Merge order: this PR → `dev`, then #6801 → `dev`. All commits are signed and signed off; original #6801 history was preserved without a force-push.

@@ -11,6 +11,44 @@ The script reuses the normal Megatron-LM training stack:
 
 No model class or custom dataset class is introduced by this example.
 
+## Runtime cost models and async planning
+
+The existing classic CP ProcessGroups and TE attention path can use either
+in-tree CPU solver. Add a model to enable the runtime planner:
+
+```text
+--dynamic-cp-runtime-model calibrated_attention
+--dynamic-cp-runtime-model-options '{"hardware":"gb200","query_heads":32,"kv_heads":4,"head_dim":128,"layer_count":48,"allow_provisional":true}'
+```
+
+The default lightweight solver searches legal power-of-two CP widths and
+size-aligned rank intervals. Select the independent DynamicUSP allocator with
+`--dynamic-cp-runtime-solver dynamic_usp`; model and solver selection are
+independent. No custom native transport or external scheduler package is needed.
+The frozen models have limited calibration domains; see the
+[model and solver documentation](../../megatron/core/datasets/dcp_runtime_scheduler/README.md)
+before using their predictions.
+
+A persistent CPU worker on the DPxCP leader prepares one future schedule while
+the current batch trains. Use `--no-dynamic-cp-runtime-async` as a same-solver
+synchronous control and `--dynamic-cp-runtime-trace-dir PATH` for timing, input
+digests, executed rows and worker telemetry. PP1/VPP1 and sequence-parallel size
+one are currently required. Mock varlen data or DataLoader workers enable the
+lookahead training hook; evaluation and external iterators do not read ahead.
+Stochastic transforms must run in DataLoader workers to preserve training RNG.
+`--dynamic-cp-runtime-force-powers` is a baseline-only diagnostic and bypasses
+the solver; it is disabled by default.
+
+## Topology-aware scheduling
+
+For a Cartesian rank mapping, `--dynamic-cp-nvlink-domain-size 8` declares that
+each consecutive eight global ranks share an NVLink domain. The heuristic
+maps those domains into the DPxCP groups and scores exposed communication with
+`--dynamic-cp-communication-cost 1024 2304`. These equivalent-token weights are
+configurable reference coefficients, not a latency calibration. Classic CP
+keeps power-of-two widths and size-aligned starts during placement and spare-rank
+allocation. Omitting the domain size preserves compute-only scheduling.
+
 ## Run

+def _get_dynamic_cp_nvlink_domains(

+    """Return a common contiguous NVLink partition for all Cartesian TP/PP planes.

+    Physical domains are declared consecutive global-rank blocks. Megatron's rank
+    generator uses additive Cartesian strides, so translating explicit group ranks
+    enumerates all planes without communication. A boundary in any plane becomes a
+    shared boundary, ensuring independently scheduled PP stages use the same costs.

+# CPU-only runtime DCP planning
+
+This package contains the lightweight planner, physical-capacity and rank-row
+contracts, CP/EP forward/backward timeline, and the frozen timing-model kernels
+and parameters. It does not need the external `dcp-scheduler` repository.
+`ORIGIN.json` identifies the source commit, original parameter artifacts and
+hashes of the three runtime parameter files. Only selected formulas and consumed
+coefficients are packaged; historical heads, calibration reports and detailed
+prediction traces stay in the source repository. Coefficients are unchanged;
+the scalar evaluator shares geometry/dispatch validation and contains no
+offline composer or fitting diagnostics.
+
+The two solvers have the same structure: an injected cost model plus a search
+algorithm. Model and solver selection are independent; neither solver inherits
+the other's search or owns a private copy of a timing model.
+
+```text
+models/                     # all cost-model code and coefficient files
+  attention/                # FA model, frozen F/B formulas and GB200/GB300 data
+  qwen35.py, qwen35.json     # mixed FA/GDN model
+  usp_calib_v1.py, *.json    # temporary upstream U8 cost model
+  base.py, cache.py         # shared model interface and memoized pack costs
+runtime/                    # scheduling only
+  lightweight.py            # arbitrary-CP candidate search
+  dynamic_usp.py, hot_switch.py  # DynamicUSP allocation/count search
+  planner.py, timeline.py   # common validation, rank rows and complete-step scoring
+```
+
+The worker runs this package directly by file path, without importing the
+Megatron/PyTorch parent packages. A persistent leader-only CPU process solves one
+batch ahead; the training process owns data reads and distributed calls. The
+solver's time budget is cooperative, not a hard deadline. Late results are waited
+for at consumption. Use `--no-dynamic-cp-runtime-async` for a same-solver control.
+
+Available in-tree models:
+
+- `calibrated_attention`: frozen GB200/GB300 FA core forward/backward formulas.
+  Supply the query/KV heads, head dimension, layer count and measured
+  non-attention times in model options. `allow_provisional=true` is required.
+  Currently restricted to a single NVL72 domain; these core times exclude FA
+  projections, and CUDA-graph/NCCL calibration transferred to eager/native is
+  provisional, not native/eager accuracy evidence.
+- `qwen35_gb200`: the frozen W32/EP4/local16K mixed model with paired FA
+  remainders, GDN and non-attention parameters. It preserves the a55 model and
+  its explicit mixed-stack/padding-transfer limitations, not a general Qwen
+  configuration or a precision guarantee. The global partition must remain
+  contiguous and the tail policy `extend_last` for that recipe.
+- `usp_calib_v1`: temporary use of DynamicUSP's original default U8 all-to-all
+  plus ring cost profile, including its **synthetic 44-layer shape**, MoE,
+  replay, tier factors and global constant. The formulas and calibration table
+  are unchanged, not refitted for Qwen or native P2P. `allow_provisional=true`
+  is required. The model does not enable Ulysses or all-to-all communication.
+
+The training adapter uses the existing classic CP ProcessGroups and TE path.
+It restricts candidate widths to power-of-two divisors of DPxCP and group starts
+to multiples of their width. Both solvers still optimize over these candidates;
+the baseline-only control is disabled by default. Generic planner geometry can
+also describe arbitrary widths and unaligned starts for other runtime adapters.
+
+Example extra flags for a standard-FA NVL72 run (alongside the DCP,
+varlen, packed-padding and parallelism arguments):
+
+```bash
+--dynamic-cp-runtime-model calibrated_attention \
+--dynamic-cp-runtime-model-options '{"hardware":"gb200","query_heads":32,"kv_heads":4,"head_dim":128,"layer_count":48,"allow_provisional":true}' \
+--dynamic-cp-runtime-solver-options '{"time_budget_s":0.8,"max_scored_candidates":4,"max_guide_candidates":4}'
+```
+
+The Python backend needs no additional numerical packages. To use the optional
+CPU JIT backend, make Numba available in the training environment and add
+`"kernel_backend":"numba"` to model options. No CUDA kernel is launched by these
+predictors. Caller-provided `module:factory` model, solver and historical powers
+baseline hooks remain supported. `--dynamic-cp-runtime-force-powers` bypasses
+the solver search using the configured validated powers-only baseline.
+
+With `dynamic_cp_runtime_model` configured, an optional generic hot-switch solver
+is selected independently of the model. Solver/options flags alone do not enable
+the runtime path:
+
+```bash
+--dynamic-cp-runtime-solver dynamic_usp \
+--dynamic-cp-runtime-solver-options '{"candidate_count":4,"outlier_threshold":1.0}'
+```
+
+It ports DynamicUSP `solve_gbs` Stage 1: long-sample group allocation, short
+prepacking/LPT, empty-group repair, rank rotation, tier affinity, heavy-middle
+ordering and bounded microbatch-count search. Allowed power-of-two widths are
+taken from the existing geometry. Samples and physical sequence-count/padding
+limits are validated by the same rank-row contract as the default planner.
+The injected model supplies scheduling work and complete-step candidate scores;
+no heads, attention implementation or communication backend is selected by this
+solver. The configured incumbent is retained if no candidate is predicted faster.
+
+The temporary upstream-cost recipe keeps CP powers of two with a minimum of 8:
+
+```bash
+--min-dynamic-context-parallel-size 8 \
+--dynamic-cp-runtime-model usp_calib_v1 \
+--dynamic-cp-runtime-model-options '{"allow_provisional":true}' \
+--dynamic-cp-runtime-solver dynamic_usp \
+--dynamic-cp-runtime-solver-options '{"candidate_count":4,"outlier_threshold":1.0}'
+```
+
+For a 32-rank DPxCP domain, both candidates and the incumbent are restricted to
+CP8/16/32; CP24 is not supported. This recipe currently accepts DPxCP=8/16/32.
+Execution continues to use the existing TE P2P path (`cp_comm_type=p2p`),
+not the modeled U8 all-to-all. This intentional mismatch is a temporary scheduling
+proxy pending upstream updates: predictions are **not** P2P latency or speedup
+evidence. Worker/consume telemetry records the model name, source hashes and
+this scope. Switching to an updated model does not require changing the worker,
+prefetcher or communication implementation.
+
+Only the default `usp_calib_v1` formulas and its original table are imported;
+custom profile options, optional profile-specific fixed-topology Stage 2,
+PP/VPP simulation, CLI and calibration tools are not imported. Existing
+PP1/VPP1 restrictions, the CPU worker, async lookahead and sync control are
+unchanged. No external `hot_switch_solver` installation is needed. Upstream
+revision and license are recorded in `DYNAMIC_USP_NOTICE.txt`.

+"""Cost-model factories, independent of the selected scheduler."""
+
+from .attention.model import AttentionCostModel, CorePredictor

+
+__all__ = ['AttentionCostModel', 'CorePredictor', 'make_model', 'qwen35_new_core_model']

+
+def qwen35_new_core_model(*, fa_remainder=None, non_attention=None, kernel_backend='python'):
+    """The exact a55 Qwen3.5 model, with its paired frozen inputs in this package."""
+    from .qwen35 import Qwen35CoreCostModel
+
+    if fa_remainder is None:
+        fa_remainder = load_parameters('qwen35.json')[0]['fa_remainder']
+    predictor = CorePredictor(
+        query_heads=32, kv_heads=2, head_dim=256, kernel_backend=kernel_backend
+    )
+    return Qwen35CoreCostModel(predictor, fa_remainder=fa_remainder, non_attention=non_attention)
+
+
+def make_model(name, geometry, **options):
+    """Resolve an in-tree model name without importing the Megatron package."""
+    if name == 'calibrated_attention':
+        return AttentionCostModel(geometry, **options)
+    if name == 'usp_calib_v1':
+        from .usp_calib_v1 import USPCalibV1CostModel
+
+        return USPCalibV1CostModel(geometry, **options)
+    if name in ('qwen35_gb200', 'dcp_scheduler.adapters:qwen35_new_core_model'):
+        return qwen35_new_core_model(**options)
+    raise ValueError(f'Unknown in-tree DCP cost model: {name}')

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Frozen CP1 and ring backward costs, with hardware-specific attribution."""
+
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+from .predictor import (
+    MIB,
+    TILE,
+    AttentionModel,
+    active_pieces,
+    ceil_div,
+    round_pieces,
+    static_ms,
+    tile_of,
+)
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1024)
+def kernel_dispatch(units, slots, rho):
+    """Greedy wave duration and the critical slot's integer chain quantities."""
+    from .dispatch import dispatch_chain
+
+    return dispatch_chain(units, slots, rho)
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=4096)
+def kernel_dispatch_tiles(tiles, mask, q_heads, rows, slots, rho):
+    """Dispatch pack, head, then KV block in the frozen kernel order."""
+    block = int(rows) // TILE
+    if block < 1 or int(rows) % TILE:
+        raise ValueError(f"Backward block rows must be a positive multiple of {TILE}")
+    units = []
+    for q, kv in tiles:
+        if mask == "causal":
+            per_head = [max(1, q - (b - 1) * block) for b in range(1, ceil_div(q, block) + 1)]
+        elif mask == "rectangle":
+            per_head = [q] * ceil_div(kv, block)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(mask)
+        units.extend(per_head * int(q_heads))
+    return kernel_dispatch(tuple(units), slots, rho)
+
+
+def helper_terms(spec, head_dim, q_heads, kv_heads, q_tokens, kv_tokens, count):
+    """Selected token-linear (GB200 CP1) or head-token-linear helper costs."""
+    block = (spec or {}).get(str(head_dim)) or (spec or {}).get(head_dim)
+    if not block:
+        return 0.0, 0.0
+    values = []
+    for which, heads, tokens in (("H_q", q_heads, q_tokens), ("H_kv", kv_heads, kv_tokens)):
+        term = block[which]
+        coef = term.get("coef", term)
+        if term.get("form", "head_token" if "h0_us" in coef else "token") == "head_token":
+            value = (
+                float(coef.get("h0_us", 0.0))
+                + float(coef.get("c_us_per_head_token", 0.0)) * float(tokens) * float(heads)
+                + float(coef.get("c_n_us_per_sequence", 0.0)) * float(count)
+            )
+        else:
+            value = (
+                float(coef.get("o0_us", 0.0))
+                + float(coef.get("o_q_us_per_token", 0.0)) * float(q_tokens)
+                + float(coef.get("o_kv_us_per_token", 0.0)) * float(kv_tokens)
+                + float(coef.get("o_n_us_per_sequence", 0.0)) * float(count)
+            )
+        values.append(value)
+    return tuple(values)
+
+
+class BackwardModel(AttentionModel):
+    """One scalar path for both frozen heads; no offline composer/trace layers.
+
+    GB200 chooses the critical rank at the reference clock, then scales it.
+    GB300 chooses at the production clock. Keep that distinction and the original
+    addition order: changing either can change solver decisions.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, hardware):
+        super().__init__(hardware, "backward")
+        self.cp1, self.ring = self.fit["cp1"], self.fit["ring"]
+        self.static_per_call = self.fit["round"] == 2
+        self.scale = float(self.ring.get("kernel_scale", 1.0))
+        self.f0 = float(self.cp1.get("f0_mhz") or 1600.0)
+        self.law = self.ring["clock"]["law"]
+        self.helpers_follow = bool(self.ring["clock"]["helpers_clock_following"])
+        if (
+            self.cp1["form"] != "F5b-1+jmax"
+            or self.cp1["static"]["form"] != "forward_slots"
+            or self.cp1["u_treatment"] != "none"
+            or self.law["kind"] != "structural"
+            or self.ring["glue"]["prep_mode"] != "class_direct"
+            or self.ring["glue"]["helpers"]["mode"] != "active_tokens"
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Unsupported frozen backward formula")
+        self.static_us = float(self.cp1.get("static_us_per_slot", 0.155))
+
+    @lru_cache(maxsize=8192)
+    def _clock(self, tile_ms, const_ms, frequency):
+        lam = float(self.law["lambda"])
+        scaled, unscaled = tile_ms + (1.0 - lam) * const_ms, lam * const_ms
+        factor = self.f0 / float(frequency) if frequency else 1.0
+        return scaled * factor + unscaled
+
+    @lru_cache(maxsize=200000)
+    def _kernel(self, profile, mask, pieces, storage):
+        q_heads, kv_heads, head_dim = self.geometries[profile]
+        cs = self.cp1["geometries"][profile][mask]
+        if cs["status"] != "fitted":
+            raise ValueError(f"No fitted {mask} coefficients for {profile}")
+        structural = self.cp1["structural"]
+        rows = int(
+            structural["R_bwd_rows_by_head_dim"].get(str(head_dim), structural["R_bwd_rows"])
+        )
+        slots = int(structural["P_bwd_by_head_dim"][str(head_dim)])
+        active = active_pieces(pieces)
+        tiles = tuple((tile_of(q), tile_of(kv)) for q, kv in active)
+        rho = float(cs["rho_tiles"])
+        _, chain, chain_tiles, count, longest = kernel_dispatch_tiles(
+            tiles, mask, q_heads, rows, slots, rho
+        )
+        split = {
+            "tau_ms_per_tile": (float(chain_tiles), rho * chain),
+            "tau_jmax_ms_per_tile": (float(longest) if count > slots else 0.0, 0.0),
+        }
+        tile_ms = sum(float(cs[c]) * split[c][0] for c in split if c in cs)
+        const_sched_ms = sum(float(cs[c]) * split[c][1] for c in split if c in cs)
+        static = static_ms(len(active), self.static_us, self.thd_max)
+        const_ms = (
+            float(cs["k0_ms"])
+            + float(cs["b_S_ms_per_token"]) * float(storage)
+            + const_sched_ms
+            + static
+        )
+        helper = self.cp1.get("helper_terms") or {}
+        hq, hkv = helper_terms(
+            helper.get("by_head_dim") if helper.get("applied") else None,
+            head_dim,
+            q_heads,
+            kv_heads,
+            sum(q for q, _ in active),
+            sum(kv for _, kv in active),
+            len(active),
+        )
+        return tile_ms, const_ms, static, (hq + hkv) * 0.001
+
+    @lru_cache(maxsize=8192)
+    def _glue(self, profile, mq, mkv, count, q_tokens, kv_tokens, nbytes):
+        q_heads, kv_heads, head_dim = self.geometries[profile]
+        glue = self.ring["glue"]
+        prep = glue["prep"]
+        prep_us = (
+            float(prep.get("p0_us", 0.0))
+            + float(prep.get("p_q_us_per_MiB_q", 0.0)) * float(mq)

+            # GB200's reference-clock choice must precede the clock transformation.

+        )

+"""Frozen CPU prediction kernel; provenance is recorded in ORIGIN.json."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import heapq
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from contextvars import ContextVar
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+_BACKEND = ContextVar("attention_dispatch_backend", default="python")
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def dispatch_backend(name):
+    """Select a dispatch evaluator within this context and restore the previous choice."""
+    if name not in ("python", "numba"):
+        raise ValueError("dispatch backend must be python or numba")
+    token = _BACKEND.set(name)
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        _BACKEND.reset(token)
+
+
+def _chain(units, slots, rho):
+    count = len(units)
+    if count == 0:
+        return 0.0, 0, 0, 0, 0
+    maximum = int(max(units))
+    if count <= slots:
+        return rho + float(maximum), 1, maximum, count, maximum
+    if rho + float(maximum) > 0 and min(units) == maximum:
+        waves = (count + slots - 1) // slots
+        end = 0.0
+        for _ in range(waves):
+            end += rho + float(maximum)
+        return end, waves, waves * maximum, count, maximum
+    heap = [(0.0, i) for i in range(slots)]
+    chains = [0] * slots
+    tiles = [0] * slots
+    end, critical = 0.0, 0
+    for value in units:
+        finish, index = heap[0]
+        finish += rho + float(value)
+        chains[index] += 1
+        tiles[index] += int(value)
+        heapq.heapreplace(heap, (finish, index))
+        if finish > end:
+            end, critical = finish, index
+    return end, chains[critical], tiles[critical], count, maximum
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def _compiled():
+    try:
+        from numba import njit
+    except ImportError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "numba dispatch requires optional numba; use kernel_backend='python' otherwise"
+        ) from exc
+    return njit(cache=True, fastmath=False, parallel=False)(_chain)
+
+
+def compiled_chain(units, slots, rho):
+    """Integer tile units only; return the Python oracle's exact five quantities."""
+    import numpy as np
+
+    if slots <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("slots must be positive")
+    return _compiled()(np.asarray(units, dtype=np.int64), int(slots), float(rho))
+
+
+def accelerated_chain(units, slots, rho):
+    """Evaluate the optional compiled dispatch chain, or defer to the Python caller."""
+    if _BACKEND.get() == "python":
+        return None
+    return compiled_chain(units, slots, rho)
+
+
+def dispatch_chain(units, slots, rho):
+    """Shared integer-tile dispatch for Python and optional Numba execution."""
+    result = accelerated_chain(units, slots, rho)
+    return _chain(units, int(slots), float(rho)) if result is None else result

+    def __init__(
+        self,

+        query_heads=32,
+        kv_heads=4,
+        head_dim=128,
+        tokens_per_rank=16384,
+        dataset_alignment=64,
+        kernel_backend='python',

+        if kernel_backend not in ('python', 'numba'):
+            raise ValueError('kernel_backend must be python or numba')

+            type(value) is not int or value <= 0
+            for value in (query_heads, kv_heads, head_dim, tokens_per_rank, dataset_alignment)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError('Prediction geometry requires positive integers')

+        self.geometry = (query_heads, kv_heads, head_dim)

+        for model in self.models.values():
+            model.geometry_profile(*self.geometry)

+        if type(cp) is not int or cp < 1 or not lengths or len(lengths) > 64:

+        if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in lengths):
+            raise ValueError('Logical sequence lengths must be positive integers')
+        if ranks is not None:

+            if (
+                len(ranks) != cp
+                or not ranks
+                or ranks[0] < 0

+            ):

+        with dispatch_backend(self.kernel_backend):
+            result = {}
+            options = dict(
+                query_heads=self.geometry[0],
+                kv_heads=self.geometry[1],
+                head_dim=self.geometry[2],
+                storage_tokens=self.tokens_per_rank,
+                sequence_alignment=2 * cp,
+                dataset_alignment=self.dataset_alignment,
+                clock_law='two_term',
+                use_production_default_clock=True,
+            )
+            for phase, model in self.models.items():
+                result[phase + '_ms'] = float(model.predict_time_ms(lengths, cp, **options))
+        if any(not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0 for value in result.values()):
+            raise ValueError('Invalid frozen attention prediction')
+        return result
+

+        """Report coefficient provenance, prediction geometry and transfer limitations."""
+        return dict(

+            geometry=list(self.geometry),

+            clock_input='production_default',
+            heads={p: m.head for p, m in self.models.items()},
+            model_sha256={p: m.data_sha256 for p, m in self.models.items()},
+            runtime_parameters_sha256={p: m.parameter_sha256 for p, m in self.models.items()},
+            head_status={p: m.head_status for p, m in self.models.items()},

+class AttentionCostModel:

+
+    name = 'calibrated_attention'
+    placement_invariant = True
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        geometry,
+        *,
+        hardware='gb200',
+        query_heads=32,
+        kv_heads=4,
+        head_dim=128,
+        layer_count=1,
+        forward_non_attention_ms=0.0,

+    ):

+        if type(layer_count) is not int or layer_count <= 0:
+            raise ValueError('layer_count must be a positive integer')
+        if any(
+            not math.isfinite(v) or v < 0
+            for v in (forward_non_attention_ms, backward_non_attention_ms)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError('Non-attention times must be finite and nonnegative')
+        self.geometry = geometry
+        self.layer_count = layer_count

+
+    def forward(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None):
+        """Predict per-layer FA core forward time in milliseconds for one CP pack."""
+        return self._costs(tuple(lengths), cp)[0]
+
+    def backward(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None):
+        """Predict per-layer FA core backward time in milliseconds for one CP pack."""
+        return self._costs(tuple(lengths), cp)[1]

+                            dict(sync='ep', duration_ms=self.backward_non_attention_ms),

+        self._costs.cache_clear()

+    def check_domain(self, geometry, config=None):
+        """Require the planner geometry used to initialize this model."""
+        if geometry != self.geometry:

+    def metadata(self):

+        return dict(
+            core=self.core.metadata(),

+        )

+BLOCK_ROWS = 256
+HEAD_DIM_HALF_OCCUPANCY = 256

+    'attention/gb300.json': 'c6ea0650b7dcb37e76c4a56452d7eee85e8bef5d985480ad4e09a5c9ad45d73a',

+def load_parameters(name: str) -> tuple[dict, str]:
+    """Load one immutable runtime parameter file with its pinned SHA256."""
+    if name not in PARAMETER_HASHES:
+        raise ValueError(f'Unsupported parameter file: {name}')
+    raw = (Path(__file__).parent.parent / name).read_bytes()
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+    if digest != PARAMETER_HASHES[name]:
+        raise ValueError(f'Frozen runtime parameter hash mismatch: {name}')
+    payload = json.loads(raw)

+        raise ValueError('Unsupported runtime parameter schema')

+def chunk_pair(valid_length: int, padded_length: int, cp_size: int, rank: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Valid tokens in a rank's first and mirrored second zigzag chunks."""
+    if cp_size <= 0 or not 0 <= rank < cp_size:
+        raise ValueError(f'Invalid CP rank {rank} for CP={cp_size}')
+    if padded_length < valid_length or padded_length % (2 * cp_size):
+        raise ValueError('Padded length must cover valid tokens and be divisible by 2CP')
+    chunk = padded_length // (2 * cp_size)
+    first = min(max(valid_length - rank * chunk, 0), chunk)
+    second_chunk_index = 2 * cp_size - rank - 1
+    second = min(max(valid_length - second_chunk_index * chunk, 0), chunk)
+    return first, second
+
+
+def layout_extend_last(lengths, cp_size, storage_tokens, alignment, dataset_alignment=1):
+    """Round each length to dataset then CP alignment; extend the last to S x CP."""
+    values = [int(v) for v in lengths]
+    if not values or min(values) <= 0:
+        raise ValueError('lengths must contain positive sequence lengths')
+    cp, storage, align = (int(cp_size), int(storage_tokens), int(alignment))
+    dataset_align = int(dataset_alignment)
+    if cp <= 0 or storage <= 0 or align <= 0 or (dataset_align <= 0):
+        raise ValueError('cp_size, storage_tokens and alignment must be positive')
+    dataset_padded = [-(-v // dataset_align) * dataset_align for v in values]
+    padded = [-(-v // align) * align for v in dataset_padded]
+    capacity = storage * cp
+    if sum(padded) > capacity:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f'aligned storage {sum(padded)} exceeds the pack capacity {capacity} '
+            f'(storage {storage} tokens per rank x cp {cp}, alignment {align})'
+        )
+    padded[-1] += capacity - sum(padded)
+    if cp > 1 and any((v % (2 * cp) for v in padded)):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f'padded lengths {padded} are not divisible by 2 x cp = {2 * cp}: '
+            f'alignment {align} does not support the zigzag layout at cp {cp}'
+        )
+    return padded

+@lru_cache(maxsize=256)
+def _round_pieces(lengths, padded, cp_size):
+    if cp_size <= 1 or len(lengths) != len(padded) or (not lengths) or (min(lengths) <= 0):
+        raise ValueError('round geometry requires CP > 1 and matching positive lengths')
+    chunks = [
+        [chunk_pair(n, p, cp_size, rank) for n, p in zip(lengths, padded)]
+        for rank in range(cp_size)
+    ]
+    first = [tuple((a for a, _ in row)) for row in chunks]
+    second = [tuple((b for _, b in row)) for row in chunks]
+    full = [tuple((a + b for a, b in row)) for row in chunks]
+    physical = sum(padded) // cp_size
+    out, piece_cache = ([], {})
+    for rank in range(cp_size):
+        for step in range(cp_size):
+            kv_rank = (rank - step) % cp_size
+            if step == 0:
+                section, q, kv, pq, pk = ('diagonal', full[rank], full[kv_rank], physical, physical)
+            elif step <= rank:
+                section, q, kv, pq, pk = (
+                    'lower',
+                    full[rank],
+                    first[kv_rank],
+                    physical,
+                    physical // 2,
+                )
+            else:
+                section, q, kv, pq, pk = (
+                    'upper',
+                    second[rank],
+                    full[kv_rank],
+                    physical // 2,
+                    physical,
+                )
+            key = (q, kv)
+            pieces = piece_cache.get(key)
+            if pieces is None:
+                pieces = piece_cache[key] = tuple(
+                    ((a, b) for a, b in zip(q, kv) if a > 0 and b > 0)
+                )
+            out.append(
+                dict(
+                    rank=rank,
+                    step=step,
+                    kv_rank=kv_rank,
+                    section=section,
+                    pieces=pieces,
+                    q_physical=pq,
+                    kv_physical=pk,
+                )
+            )

+
+def round_pieces(lengths, padded, cp_size):
+    """Valid-token pieces for each rank and causal zigzag ring step."""
+    return _round_pieces(
+        tuple((int(v) for v in lengths)), tuple((int(v) for v in padded)), int(cp_size)
+    )

+    return -(-int(a) // int(b))

+    return max(1, ceil_div(tokens, tile))

+    return [(int(q), int(kv)) for q, kv in pieces if int(q) > 0 and int(kv) > 0]

+            [min(2 * b, tq) for b in range(1, blocks + 1)] if mask == 'causal' else [tkv] * blocks
+        )
+        out.extend(per_piece * int(q_heads))
+    return out
+
+
+def makespan(kv_tiles, P, rho):
+    """Greedy kernel-wave duration in rho-plus-tile units, in dispatch order."""
+    from .dispatch import dispatch_chain
+
+    if int(P) <= 0:
+        raise ValueError('P must be positive')
+    return dispatch_chain(kv_tiles, P, rho)[0]
+
+
+def static_ms(n_active, us_per_slot, thd_max):
+    """Fixed static-batch term: each empty slot of a thd_max-sized batch costs us_per_slot."""
+    return float(us_per_slot) * 0.001 * (int(thd_max) - int(n_active))
+
+
+def topology_class_for_cp(topology, cp_size):
+    """Recorded communication class, otherwise the calibration's node-size rule."""
+    cp = int(cp_size)
+    if cp < 2:
+        raise ValueError('the ring layer needs cp >= 2')
+    classes = topology.get('classes') or {}
+    for name, record in classes.items():
+        if cp in [int(c) for c in record.get('cps') or []]:
+            return (name, record.get('role'))
+    by_role = topology.get('class_by_role') or {}
+    gpus = int(topology.get('gpus_per_node') or 4)
+    role = 'pair' if cp == 2 else 'intra_node' if cp <= gpus else 'inter_node'
+    name = by_role.get(role)
+    if name is None:
+        raise ValueError(f'the topology block has no {role!r} class for cp {cp}')
+    return (name, role)
+
+
+class AttentionModel:
+    """Shared frozen-parameter, geometry and physical-layout contract."""
+
+    def __init__(self, hardware, phase):
+        self.data, self.parameter_sha256 = load_parameters(f'attention/{hardware}.json')
+        if self.data['hardware'] != hardware:
+            raise ValueError('Calibration hardware mismatch')
+        self.fit = self.data[phase]
+        self.phase = phase
+        self.data_sha256 = self.data['source_sha256']
+        self.head, self.head_status = self.fit['head'], self.fit['head_status']
+        self.known_limits = self.fit['known_limits']
+        self.topology = self.data['topology']
+        self.alignment_default = int(self.data['layout']['alignment_default'])
+        self.production_default_clock_mhz = self.data['production_clock_mhz']
+        cp1 = self.fit['cp1']
+        self.thd_max = int(cp1.get('thd_max', cp1.get('static', {}).get('thd_max', 64)))
+        keys = (
+            ('q_heads', 'kv_heads', 'head_dim')
+            if phase == 'backward'
+            else ('query_heads', 'kv_heads', 'head_dim')
+        )
+        self.geometries = {
+            name: tuple(int(g[k]) for k in keys)
+            for name, g in cp1.get('geometry_params', cp1['geometries']).items()
+        }
+        self._profile_by_shape = {shape: name for name, shape in self.geometries.items()}
+
+    def geometry_profile(self, query_heads, kv_heads, head_dim):
+        """Resolve a coefficient profile for the supplied attention head geometry."""
+        key = int(query_heads), int(kv_heads), int(head_dim)
+        if key not in self._profile_by_shape:
+            raise ValueError(f'No {self.phase} coefficient set for geometry {key}')
+        return self._profile_by_shape[key]
+
+    def structure_for_cp(self, cp):
+        """Use the pinned communication class or its recorded topology rule."""
+        if cp < 2:
+            raise ValueError('The ring layer requires CP >= 2')
+        ring = self.fit['ring']
+        structure = ring['structure_of_cp'].get(str(cp))
+        if structure is None:
+            structure, _ = topology_class_for_cp(self.topology, cp)
+        if structure not in ring['W0']:
+            raise ValueError(f'No communication coefficients for {structure!r}')
+        return structure
+
+    def predict_time_ms(
+        self,
+        lengths,
+        cp_size,
+        *,
+        query_heads,
+        kv_heads,
+        head_dim,
+        storage_tokens,
+        sequence_alignment=None,
+        dataset_alignment=1,
+        clock_law=DEFAULT_CLOCK_LAW,
+        use_production_default_clock=False,
+    ):
+        """Scalar execution of the frozen formula; no prediction trace allocation."""
+        if clock_law not in ('alpha', 'two_term'):
+            raise ValueError('Unsupported clock input')
+        values = tuple(int(n) for n in lengths)
+        cp, storage = int(cp_size), int(storage_tokens)
+        if len(values) > self.thd_max:
+            raise ValueError('Pack exceeds static sequence slots')
+        profile = self.geometry_profile(query_heads, kv_heads, head_dim)
+        alignment = (
+            self.alignment_default if sequence_alignment is None else int(sequence_alignment)
+        )
+        padded = layout_extend_last(values, cp, storage, alignment, dataset_alignment)
+        frequency = (
+            float(self.production_default_clock_mhz[self.phase])
+            if use_production_default_clock
+            else None
+        )
+        return self._predict(profile, storage, cp, values, padded, frequency, clock_law)
+
+
+class ForwardModel(AttentionModel):
+    """Selected forward CP1 wave and ring formulas; no historical heads or traces."""
+
+    def __init__(self, hardware: str):
+        super().__init__(hardware, 'forward')
+        fit = self.fit
+        cp1, constants = fit['cp1'], self.data['constants']
+        self.tile = int(cp1.get('tile', constants['tile_tokens']))
+        self.block_rows = int(cp1.get('block_rows', constants['block_rows']))
+        if self.block_rows % self.tile:
+            raise ValueError('Block rows must be divisible by tile size')
+        half = cp1.get('head_dim_half_occupancy', constants['head_dim_half_occupancy'])
+        self.half_occupancy_head_dim = None if half is None else int(half)
+        self.p_hw = int(cp1['P_hw'])
+        self.static_us_per_slot = float(cp1['static_us_per_slot'])
+        self.o_graph, self.ring = fit['o_graph'], fit['ring']
+        self.ring_kernel_scale = float(fit['kernel_scale'])
+        self.clock = fit['clock']
+        self.f0_mhz = float(self.clock['f0_mhz'])
+        self.alpha = float(self.clock['alpha'])
+        self.two_term_s = float(self.clock['two_term_s'])
+        self.sequential_pair_structure = self.ring['sequential_pair_structure']
+        self.kappa_W0 = float(self.ring['kappa_W0'])
+        self.kappa_W0_pair = float(self.ring.get('kappa_W0_sequential_pair', 0.0))
+        self._kernel_cache = {}
+
+    def f5(self, profile, mask, pieces, S_tokens, n_static=None):
+        """Tile-rounded, cached fused-attention wall at the reference clock."""
+        tiles = tuple(
+            ((tile_of(q, self.tile), tile_of(kv, self.tile)) for q, kv in active_pieces(pieces))
+        )
+        return self._f5_tiles(profile, mask, tiles, int(S_tokens), n_static)
+
+    @lru_cache(maxsize=8192)
+    def _f5_tiles(self, profile, mask, tiles, S_tokens, n_static):
+        q_heads, _kv, head_dim = self.geometries[profile]
+        pieces = [(q * self.tile, kv * self.tile) for q, kv in tiles]
+        coefficients = self.fit['cp1']['geometries'][profile][mask]
+        units = units_kv(pieces, mask, q_heads, self.tile, self.block_rows)
+        slots = slots_for(
+            head_dim, int(coefficients.get('P_hw', self.p_hw)), self.half_occupancy_head_dim
+        )
+        span = makespan(units, slots, float(coefficients['rho_kvtiles']))
+        k0 = float(coefficients['k0_ms'])
+        bS = float(coefficients['b_S_ms_per_token']) * float(S_tokens)
+        schedule = float(coefficients['tau_ms_per_kvtile']) * span
+        tau = float(coefficients.get('tau_jmax_ms_per_kvtile') or 0.0)
+        tail = tau * max(units, default=0) if tau and len(units) > slots else 0.0
+        static = static_ms(
+            len(pieces) if n_static is None else int(n_static),
+            self.static_us_per_slot,
+            self.thd_max,
+        )
+        return k0 + bS + schedule + tail + static
+
+    def o_graph_ms(self, P_q, profile):
+        """Per-call overhead from physical Q bytes, excluded from kernel scaling."""
+        q_heads, _kv, head_dim = self.geometries[profile]
+        mib = float(P_q) * (q_heads * head_dim) * 2.0 / MIB
+        return (float(self.o_graph['o0_us']) + float(self.o_graph['o1_us_per_MiB']) * mib) * 0.001
+
+    def ring_terms(self, cp_size, storage_tokens, profile):
+        """Communication/glue terms shared by every rank, in milliseconds."""
+        cp, S = (int(cp_size), int(storage_tokens))
+        q_heads, kv_heads, head_dim = self.geometries[profile]
+        structure = self.structure_for_cp(cp)
+        w0 = self.ring['W0'][structure]
+        payload_bytes = 2 * S * kv_heads * head_dim * 2
+        W0_us = float(w0['latency_us']) + float(w0['us_per_byte']) * int(payload_bytes)
+        x = S * (q_heads * head_dim)
+        mib = x * 2 / MIB
+        chain0 = (
+            float(self.ring['chain_0_comm']['a0_us'])
+            + float(self.ring['chain_0_comm']['a1_us_per_elem']) * x
+        )
+        gmid = float(self.ring['g_mid']['b0_us']) + float(self.ring['g_mid']['b1_us_per_elem']) * x
+        c_tail = float(self.ring['c_tail_us_per_MiB'])
+        sequential = structure == self.sequential_pair_structure
+        kappa = self.kappa_W0_pair if sequential else self.kappa_W0
+        W0_ms = W0_us * 0.001
+        stretch_ms = kappa * W0_ms
+        return {
+            'cp': cp,
+            'sequential_pair': sequential,
+            'W0_ms': W0_ms,
+            'chain0_comm_ms': chain0 * 0.001,
+            'gmid_ms': gmid * 0.001,
+            'tail_ms': cp * c_tail * mib * 0.001,
+            'stretch_ms': stretch_ms,
+        }
+
+    def first_exchange(self, terms, k0_ms):
+        """Residual first exchange plus preparation for the next ring step."""
+        W0 = terms['W0_ms']
+        cp = terms['cp']
+        if terms['sequential_pair']:
+            rem = 0.5 * W0 + max(0.0, 0.5 * W0 - k0_ms)
+        else:
+            rem = max(0.0, W0 - k0_ms)
+        last_round = cp == 2
+        P1 = terms['chain0_comm_ms'] if last_round else 2.0 * terms['gmid_ms']
+        return rem + P1
+
+    def round_kernel(self, profile, section, pieces, storage_tokens, q_physical):
+        """Cached round kernel: CP1-form wall minus physical-Q overhead."""
+        mask = SECTION_MASK[section]
+        S_tokens = (
+            int(q_physical)
+            if q_physical
+            else int(storage_tokens) // 2 if section == 'upper' else int(storage_tokens)
+        )
+        key = (profile, mask, tuple(pieces), S_tokens)
+        hit = self._kernel_cache.get(key)
+        if hit is None:
+            raw = self.f5(profile, mask, list(pieces), S_tokens)
+            og = self.o_graph_ms(S_tokens, profile)
+            hit = raw - og
+            if len(self._kernel_cache) > 200000:
+                self._kernel_cache.clear()
+            self._kernel_cache[key] = hit
+        return hit
+
+    def _predict(self, profile, S, cp, values, padded, frequency, clock_law):
+        clock_scale = None
+        if frequency:
+            ratio = self.f0_mhz / frequency
+            clock_scale = (
+                self.two_term_s * ratio + (1.0 - self.two_term_s)
+                if clock_law == 'two_term'
+                else ratio**self.alpha
+            )
+        if cp == 1:
+            wall = self.f5(profile, 'causal', [(v, v) for v in values], S)
+            og = self.o_graph_ms(S, profile)
+            return wall if clock_scale is None else og + (wall - og) * clock_scale
+        terms = self.ring_terms(cp, S, profile)
+        scale = (
+            self.ring_kernel_scale if clock_scale is None else clock_scale * self.ring_kernel_scale
+        )
+        k = [[0.0] * cp for _ in range(cp)]
+        for item in round_pieces(values, padded, cp):
+            kr = self.round_kernel(profile, item['section'], item['pieces'], S, item['q_physical'])
+            k[item['rank']][item['step']] = kr * scale
+        sums = [sum(row) for row in k]
+        crit = max(range(cp), key=lambda rank: sums[rank])
+        kernel = sums[crit] + cp * terms['stretch_ms']
+        glue = terms['chain0_comm_ms'] + (cp - 2) * terms['gmid_ms'] + terms['tail_ms']
+        first_exchange = self.first_exchange(terms, k[crit][0] + terms['stretch_ms'])
+        return kernel + glue + first_exchange

+"""Shared cost-model protocol and geometry-only smoke model."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations

+@runtime_checkable
+class DcpCostModel(Protocol):
+    """Callable contract consumed by ``models.cache.PackCostModel`` and the planner."""
+
+    name: str
+    source_hashes: Dict[str, str]
+    program_costs: Optional[Callable[..., Dict[str, float]]]
+
+    def forward(
+        self, lengths: Tuple[int, ...], cp: int, *, ranks: Optional[Sequence[int]] = None
+    ) -> float:
+        """Forward attention ms per layer for one pack."""
+
+    def backward(
+        self, lengths: Tuple[int, ...], cp: int, *, ranks: Optional[Sequence[int]] = None
+    ) -> float:
+        """Backward attention ms per layer for one pack."""
+
+    def timing(self) -> Optional[dict]:
+        """Execution program for ``TimelineModel`` (program mode) or None (scalar mode)."""
+
+    def clear(self) -> None:
+        """Drop memoized pack costs."""
+
+    def check_domain(self, geometry: "RuntimePlanGeometry", config) -> None:
+        """Raise ValueError when the geometry/config is outside the calibrated domain."""
+
+
+class QuadraticCostModel:
+    """Geometry-agnostic smoke model: ms = sum((stored/cp)^2)/1e6 + cp_step_ms*(cp-1).
+
+    Scalar timeline (no execution program); test/smoke only.
+    """
+
+    name = "quadratic"
+    program_costs = None
+    layer_count = 1
+    forward_non_attention_ms = 1.0
+    backward_non_attention_ms = 2.0
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, geometry: "RuntimePlanGeometry", cp_step_ms: float = 0.05, **_ignored
+    ) -> None:
+        self.geometry = geometry
+        self.cp_step_ms = float(cp_step_ms)
+        self.source_hashes = {"quadratic": f"cp_step_ms={self.cp_step_ms}"}
+
+    def forward(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None) -> float:
+        """Predict per-layer forward time for the quadratic smoke model."""
+        cp = int(cp)
+        if not 1 <= cp <= self.geometry.world_size:
+            raise ValueError("cp outside the world")
+        total = 0.0
+        for n in lengths:
+            per_rank = self.geometry.stored_length(int(n), cp) / cp
+            total += per_rank * per_rank
+        return total / 1e6 + self.cp_step_ms * (cp - 1)
+
+    def backward(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None) -> float:
+        """Predict per-layer backward time for the quadratic smoke model."""
+        return 2.0 * self.forward(lengths, cp, ranks=ranks)
+
+    def timing(self) -> None:
+        """Use the shared scalar timeline for this smoke model."""
+        return None
+
+    def clear(self) -> None:
+        """Accept the cache-reset hook for this stateless smoke model."""
+        return None
+
+    def check_domain(self, geometry, config) -> None:
+        """Accept any geometry supported by the shared smoke-test planner."""
+        return None

+"""Memoized exact pack costs and physical-capacity constraints."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PackCostModel:
+    """Memoize physical pack costs and enforce capacity and sequence-count limits."""
+
+    config: object  # dcp_scheduler SchedulerConfig (alignments, tokens_per_rank, ...)
+    forward: object  # callable(lengths, cp, ranks=) -> ms per layer
+    backward: object | None = None
+    program_costs: object | None = None  # callable(lengths, cp, ranks=) -> {name: ms}
+    placement_period: int | None = (
+        None  # domain size whose crossing pattern changes costs (8 on H100 NVL8)
+    )
+    max_group_seqs: int | None = None
+    stats: dict = field(default_factory=lambda: dict(calls=0, hits=0, errors=0, signature_hits=0))
+    _memo: dict = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)
+    _min_cp: dict = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)
+    _stored: dict = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------ capacity
+    @property
+    def tokens_per_rank(self):
+        """Return the physical token capacity of one rank."""
+        return self.config.tokens_per_rank
+
+    @property
+    def allowed(self):
+        """Return the CP widths available in the runtime geometry."""
+        return tuple(self.config.allowed_cp_sizes)
+
+    def stored(self, length, cp):
+        """Return the cached physically padded token count for one sequence."""
+        key = (length, cp)
+        value = self._stored.get(key)
+        if value is None:
+            value = self._stored[key] = self.config.stored_length(int(length), int(cp))
+        return value
+
+    def capacity(self, cp):
+        """Return the physical token capacity across a CP group."""
+        return cp * self.tokens_per_rank
+
+    def stored_total(self, lengths, cp):
+        """Sum physically padded token counts for a proposed pack."""
+        return sum(self.stored(n, cp) for n in lengths)
+
+    def fits(self, lengths, cp):
+        """Check the pack against sequence-count and physical-token limits."""
+        if self.max_group_seqs is not None and len(lengths) > self.max_group_seqs:
+            return False
+        return self.stored_total(lengths, cp) <= self.capacity(cp)
+
+    def min_cp(self, length):
+        """Find the first allowed CP width that can store the sequence."""
+        value = self._min_cp.get(length)
+        if value is None:
+            for cp in self.allowed:
+                if self.stored(length, cp) <= self.capacity(cp):
+                    value = cp
+                    break
+            if value is None:
+                raise ValueError(f'sequence of {length} tokens does not fit any allowed CP group')
+            self._min_cp[length] = value
+        return value
+
+    # --------------------------------------------------------------- exact
+    def pack(self, lengths, cp, start):
+        """Exact (forward_ms, backward_ms, program_costs_or_None); None if the predictor rejects."""
+        lengths = tuple(int(n) for n in lengths)
+        placement = 0 if self.placement_period is None or cp == 1 else start % self.placement_period
+        key = (lengths, cp, placement)
+        if key in self._memo:
+            self.stats['hits'] += 1
+            return self._memo[key]
+        self.stats['calls'] += 1
+        ranks = list(range(start, start + cp))
+        try:
+            program = (
+                dict(self.program_costs(lengths, cp, ranks=ranks))
+                if self.program_costs is not None
+                else None
+            )
+            fwd = float(self.forward(lengths, cp, ranks=ranks))
+            bwd = (
+                float(self.backward(lengths, cp, ranks=ranks)) if self.backward is not None else 0.0
+            )
+            value = (fwd, bwd, program)
+        except ValueError:
+            self.stats['errors'] += 1
+            value = None
+        self._memo[key] = value
+        return value

+"""Frozen Qwen3.5 mixed-layer proxy used for runtime planning, not GPU claims."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import itertools
+import json
+import math
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+from .attention.predictor import load_parameters
+
+FEATURES = (
+    'bias',
+    'cp_enabled',
+    'summary_hops',
+    'max_prefix_chain',
+    'boundary_summary_chunks_per_64',
+    'extra_local_sequences',
+)
+LAYER_TYPES = ('gdn', 'gdn', 'gdn', 'fa', 'fa')
+
+
+class GdnPredictor:
+    """Only the chunkwise GDN coefficients consumed by the selected composition."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        data, self.parameter_sha256 = load_parameters('qwen35.json')
+        self.data = data['gdn']
+        self.calibration_sha256 = self.data['source_sha256']
+        if tuple(self.data['gdn_features']) != FEATURES:
+            raise ValueError('GDN feature contract mismatch')
+
+    def metadata(self):
+        """Keep calibration provenance, geometry and transfer limitations visible."""
+        return dict(
+            profile=self.data['profile'],
+            hardware='gb200',
+            domain_size=72,
+            transport_backend='native',
+            geometry=self.data['geometry'],
+            calibration_sha256=self.calibration_sha256,
+            cost_scope='attention_module',
+            local_tokens=16384,
+            phase_split='measured_separately',
+            provisional=True,
+            provisional_reasons=[
+                'arbitrary pack/partition transfer is not universally validated',
+                'many-short-sequence packs at small odd CP are under-predicted',
+            ],
+            padding='GDN coefficients transferred from appended dummy to extend_last',
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _features(cu, cp, phase, recompute, local):
+        difference = [0] * (cp + 1)
+        chain = forward_chunks = backward_chunks = 0
+        for begin, end in zip(cu, cu[1:]):
+            first, last = (begin // local, (end - 1) // local)
+            difference[first] += 1
+            difference[last + 1] -= 1
+            chain = max(chain, last - first)
+            if last > first:
+                forward_chunks = max(forward_chunks, (local - begin % local + 63) // 64)
+                backward_chunks = max(backward_chunks, ((end - 1) % local + 64) // 64)
+                if last - first > 1:
+                    forward_chunks = backward_chunks = local // 64
+        active = maximum = 0
+        for delta in difference[:-1]:
+            active += delta
+            maximum = max(maximum, active)
+        nf = 1 if phase == 'forward_gpu_ms' else int(recompute)
+        nb = 0 if phase == 'forward_gpu_ms' else 1
+        if phase == 'forward_backward_gpu_ms':
+            nf += 1
+        return (
+            1.0,
+            float(cp > 1),
+            (nf + nb) * (cp - 1),
+            (nf + nb) * chain,
+            (nf * forward_chunks + nb * backward_chunks) / 64,
+            float(maximum - 1),
+        )
+
+
+def load_non_attention_profile(profile: str) -> dict:
+    """The paired GB200/EP4/local16K measurements of the selected proxy."""
+    if profile != 'gb200-ep4-local16384-7319138':
+        raise ValueError('Unsupported paired non-attention profile')
+    return copy.deepcopy(load_parameters('qwen35.json')[0]['non_attention'])
+
+
+def execution_timing(other, recompute):
+    """Execution timing."""
+
+    def attention(kind, phase):
+        return dict(sync='cp', cost=f'{kind}_{phase}')
+
+    def remainder(key):
+        return dict(sync='ep', duration_ms=other[key])
+
+    forward, backward = ([], [])
+    for kind in LAYER_TYPES:
+        forward.extend([attention(kind, 'f'), remainder('layer_forward')])
+    for kind in reversed(LAYER_TYPES):
+        if recompute:
+            backward.extend([attention(kind, 'f'), remainder('layer_recompute_forward')])
+        backward.extend([remainder('layer_backward'), attention(kind, 'b')])
+    backward.append(dict(sync='local', duration_ms=other['microbatch_outer']))
+    return dict(
+        execution_program=[dict(layer_count=len(LAYER_TYPES), forward=forward, backward=backward)],
+        iteration_tail_ms=other['iteration_tail'],
+    )
+
+
+class Qwen35CoreCostModel:
+    """Three calibrated GDN modules + two new FA cores and measured FA remainders.
+
+    The injected callback returns a ``forward_ms``/``backward_ms`` mapping. This
+    module imports no attention predictor or scheduler. A caller must supply a
+    paired measured FA remainder; model-minus-model offsets are rejected.
+    """
+
+    name = 'qwen35_gb200_new_core'
+    layer_count = 5
+    placement_invariant = True
+
+    def __init__(self, core_predictor, *, fa_remainder, non_attention=None):
+        if not callable(core_predictor):
+            raise TypeError('core_predictor must be callable')
+        if fa_remainder.get('status') != 'PAIRED_FA_REMAINDER_PASS':
+            raise ValueError('a measured paired FA module-minus-core input is required')
+        if (
+            fa_remainder.get('hardware') != 'gb200'
+            or fa_remainder.get('tokens_per_rank') != 16384
+            or fa_remainder.get('geometry') != [32, 2, 256]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError('FA remainder scope requires GB200 / local16K / 32,2,256')
+        remainder = fa_remainder.get('cost_ms', {})
+        if set(remainder) != {'forward', 'backward'} or any(
+            (not math.isfinite(float(v)) or v < 0 for v in remainder.values())
+        ):
+            raise ValueError('FA remainder needs finite nonnegative forward and backward costs')
+        if not fa_remainder.get('source_hashes'):
+            raise ValueError('FA remainder must identify measured source records')
+        self.core_predictor = core_predictor
+        self.fa_remainder = copy.deepcopy(fa_remainder)
+        self.non_attention = (
+            copy.deepcopy(non_attention)
+            if non_attention is not None
+            else load_non_attention_profile('gb200-ep4-local16384-7319138')
+        )
+        if self.non_attention.get('profile') != 'gb200-ep4-local16384-7319138':
+            raise ValueError('this composition requires the measured GB200 EP4/local16K profile')
+        if self.non_attention.get('status') != 'PAIRED_MODULE_PROFILE_PASS':
+            raise ValueError('a paired measured non-attention profile is required')
+        other = self.non_attention.get('cost_ms', {})
+        if set(other) != {
+            'layer_forward',
+            'layer_backward',
+            'microbatch_outer',
+            'iteration_tail',
+        } or any(
+            (
+                not isinstance(v, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(v) or v < 0
+                for v in other.values()
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ValueError('non-attention inputs must be fixed finite nonnegative measured times')
+        self.gdn = GdnPredictor()
+        self.source_hashes = {
+            'gdn_calibration': self.gdn.calibration_sha256,
+            'non_attention_input': hashlib.sha256(
+                json.dumps(self.non_attention, sort_keys=True).encode()
+            ).hexdigest(),
+            'fa_remainder_input': hashlib.sha256(
+                json.dumps(self.fa_remainder, sort_keys=True).encode()
+            ).hexdigest(),
+        }
+        self._guide_table = {}
+
+    def _gdn_costs(self, lengths, cp):
+        stored = [((n + 63) // 64 * 64 + 2 * cp - 1) // (2 * cp) * (2 * cp) for n in lengths]
+        if sum(stored) > cp * 16384:
+            raise ValueError('pack exceeds physical capacity')
+        stored[-1] += cp * 16384 - sum(stored)
+        cu = list(itertools.accumulate(stored, initial=0))
+        costs = {}
+        for phase, key in (('forward_gpu_ms', 'gdn_f'), ('backward_gpu_ms', 'gdn_b')):
+            coefficients = self.gdn.data['gdn']['plain'][phase]
+            features = self.gdn._features(cu, cp, phase, False, 16384)
+            costs[key] = sum(
+                (coefficients[name] * value for name, value in zip(FEATURES, features))
+            )
+        return costs
+
+    def prepare_guide(self, cp_sizes):
+        """Small predictor-query table for proposal ordering, NOT final scoring."""
+        for cp in cp_sizes:
+            if cp in self._guide_table:
+                continue
+            capacity = cp * 16384
+            levels = {}
+            for count in (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 16, 32, 64):
+                packs = []
+                for divisor in (64, 4, 2, 4 / 3, 1):
+                    length = max(1, int(capacity // (divisor * count)))
+                    while (
+                        count * (((length + 63) // 64 * 64 + 2 * cp - 1) // (2 * cp) * (2 * cp))
+                        > capacity
+                    ):
+                        length -= 64
+                    packs.append((length,) * count)
+                if count > 1:
+                    short = min(1024, max(1, capacity // (8 * count)))
+                    physical_short = ((short + 63) // 64 * 64 + 2 * cp - 1) // (2 * cp) * (2 * cp)
+                    available = capacity - (count - 1) * physical_short
+                    long = available // 64 * 64
+                    while (long + 2 * cp - 1) // (2 * cp) * (2 * cp) > available:
+                        long -= 64
+                    packs.append((long,) + (short,) * (count - 1))
+                rows = {}
+                for values in packs:
+                    core = self.core_predictor(values, cp, ranks=tuple(range(cp)))
+                    square = sum((length**2 for length in values)) / capacity**2
+                    rows[square] = (float(core['forward_ms']), float(core['backward_ms']))
+                levels[count] = tuple(((x, *v) for x, v in sorted(rows.items())))
+            self._guide_table[cp] = levels
+
+    def guide_program_costs(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None):
+        """Approximate FA interpolation plus exact cheap GDN for candidate ordering."""
+        return dict(self._guide_program(tuple(lengths), cp))
+
+    @lru_cache(maxsize=65536)
+    def _guide_program(self, lengths, cp):
+        levels = self._guide_table[cp]
+        count = len(lengths)
+        low = max((n for n in levels if n <= count))
+        high = min((n for n in levels if n >= count))
+        square = sum((n * n for n in lengths)) / (cp * 16384) ** 2
+
+        def interpolate(rows, index):
+            for lower, upper in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
+                if square <= upper[0]:
+                    fraction = max(0.0, min(1.0, (square - lower[0]) / (upper[0] - lower[0])))
+                    return lower[index] + fraction * (upper[index] - lower[index])
+            return rows[-1][index]
+
+        result = self._gdn_costs(lengths, cp)
+        for index, phase, key in ((1, 'forward', 'fa_f'), (2, 'backward', 'fa_b')):
+            first = interpolate(levels[low], index)
+            weight = (count - low) / (high - low) if high != low else 0.0
+            second = interpolate(levels[high], index) if high != low else first
+            result[key] = first + weight * (second - first) + self.fa_remainder['cost_ms'][phase]
+        return result
+
+    @lru_cache(maxsize=65536)
+    def _program(self, lengths, cp):
+        costs = self._gdn_costs(lengths, cp)
+        core = self.core_predictor(lengths, cp, ranks=tuple(range(cp)))
+        costs['fa_f'] = float(core['forward_ms']) + self.fa_remainder['cost_ms']['forward']
+        costs['fa_b'] = float(core['backward_ms']) + self.fa_remainder['cost_ms']['backward']
+        if any((not math.isfinite(v) or v <= 0 for v in costs.values())):
+            raise ValueError('invalid predicted mixed-layer cost')
+        return costs
+
+    def program_costs(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None):
+        """Price the frozen FA, GDN and remainder operations for one pack."""
+        values = tuple(lengths)
+        if not values or len(values) > 64 or any((type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in values)):
+            raise ValueError('one to 64 positive integer logical lengths required')
+        if type(cp) is not int or not 1 <= cp <= 32:
+            raise ValueError('the proxy covers CP1..32')
+        if ranks is not None:
+            ranks = tuple(ranks)
+            if (
+                len(ranks) != cp
+                or any((type(r) is not int for r in ranks))
+                or ranks != tuple(range(ranks[0], ranks[0] + cp))
+                or (ranks[0] < 0)
+                or (ranks[-1] >= 32)
+            ):
+                raise ValueError('the GB200 proxy requires contiguous physical ranks inside 0..31')
+        return dict(self._program(values, cp))
+
+    def forward(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None):
+        """Return mean forward time per layer for the frozen three-GDN/two-FA stack."""
+        p = self.program_costs(lengths, cp, ranks=ranks)
+        return (3 * p['gdn_f'] + 2 * p['fa_f']) / 5
+
+    def backward(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None):
+        """Return mean backward time per layer for the frozen three-GDN/two-FA stack."""
+        p = self.program_costs(lengths, cp, ranks=ranks)
+        return (3 * p['gdn_b'] + 2 * p['fa_b']) / 5
+
+    def timing(self):
+        """Describe the frozen mixed-layer program and synchronization costs."""
+        return execution_timing(self.non_attention['cost_ms'], False)
+
+    def clear(self):
+        """Clear the exact and proposal-guide pack caches for a new global batch."""
+        self._program.cache_clear()
+        self._guide_program.cache_clear()
+
+    def check_domain(self, geometry, config=None):
+        """Require the frozen W32/EP4/local16K/dataset64 proxy geometry."""
+        if (
+            geometry.world_size,
+            geometry.ep_size,
+            geometry.tokens_per_rank,
+            geometry.dataset_alignment,
+        ) != (32, 4, 16384, 64):
+            raise ValueError('the composed proxy requires W32/EP4/local16K/dataset64')
+
+    def metadata(self):
+        """Expose the frozen proxy recipe, source hashes and transfer limitations."""
+        return dict(
+            name=self.name,
+            source_hashes=self.source_hashes,
+            core=getattr(self.core_predictor, 'metadata', lambda: None)(),
+            proposal_guide=(
+                'frozen-predictor queries indexed by CP, sequence count '
+                'and sum of squared lengths; final scores exact'
+            ),
+            non_attention=self.non_attention,
+            fa_remainder=self.fa_remainder,
+            gdn=self.gdn.metadata(),
+            tail_padding='extend_last',
+            dataset_alignment=64,
+            provisional=True,
+            provisional_reasons=[
+                'mixed_eager_native_gdn_and_cuda_graph_nccl_fa',
+                'gdn_coefficients_transferred_to_extend_last_padding',
+                'measured_fixed_non_attention_transferred_to_variable_packs',
+                'cp1_fa_remainder_transferred_to_cp2_32',
+                'cp1_remainder_does_not_measure_multicp_contiguous_zigzag_conversion',
+            ],
+            scope=(
+                'attention modules plus measured fixed non-attention; '
+                'prediction, not GPU E2E measurement'
+            ),
+        )

+"""Temporary DynamicUSP U8 cost proxy; execution still uses native P2P.
+
+Default formulas and the synthetic 44-layer shape are preserved from upstream
+1ff97a4a, not refitted to Qwen or P2P. See DYNAMIC_USP_NOTICE.txt for attribution.
+Only the default profile is ported; Stage 2 and calibration tooling are omitted.
+"""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+from functools import lru_cache
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class USPCalibV1CostModel:
+    """Expose the original compute + U8 A2A + ring costs to the CPU planner.
+
+    Forward/backward include the upstream synthetic block's compute and MoE.
+    They are not attention-only times and must not receive additional MoE costs.
+    """
+
+    name = "usp_calib_v1"
+    placement_invariant = True
+    layer_count = 44
+    supported_cp_sizes = (8, 16, 32)
+
+    def __init__(self, geometry, *, allow_provisional=False) -> None:
+        if allow_provisional is not True:
+            raise ValueError("usp_calib_v1 requires explicit allow_provisional=True")
+        self.geometry = geometry
+        self.check_domain(geometry, None)
+        raw = Path(__file__).with_suffix(".json").read_bytes()
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+        if digest != "d25989552ab9700f07261231fa13d66672d98684435fff57838442ca12c19cd7":
+            raise ValueError("Frozen DynamicUSP calibration hash mismatch")
+        self.table = json.loads(raw)
+        self.source_hashes = {
+            "calib_table_v1.json": digest,
+            "usp_calib_v1.py": "a2dbcff0099936e283b2386783861d7191c5319e1cf9e22a8bff30f33207329d",
+        }
+
+    def check_domain(self, geometry, config=None):
+        """Validate the parent geometry and CP widths against the upstream profile."""
+        if geometry != self.geometry or geometry.world_size not in self.supported_cp_sizes:
+            raise ValueError("usp_calib_v1 requires a DPxCP domain of 8, 16 or 32 ranks")
+        if not geometry.allowed_cp_sizes or any(
+            cp not in self.supported_cp_sizes for cp in geometry.allowed_cp_sizes
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("usp_calib_v1 only supports CP8/16/32 (minimum CP8)")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _curve(fit, nbytes):
+        return max(fit["floor_ms"], fit["t0_ms"] + nbytes / 1e6 / fit["bw_gbps"])
+
+    @lru_cache(maxsize=65536)
+    def components(self, lengths, cp):
+        """Original full-stack group costs, plus a forward/backward decomposition."""
+        if type(cp) is not int or cp not in self.geometry.allowed_cp_sizes:
+            raise ValueError("CP size is outside the configured DynamicUSP tiers")
+        if not lengths or len(lengths) > 64 or any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in lengths):
+            raise ValueError("One to 64 positive logical sequence lengths are required")
+        total = sum(lengths)
+        squares = sum(n * n for n in lengths)
+        ring_size = max(1, cp // 8)
+        mode = f"sp{cp}"
+        compute = self.table["compute"]
+        rate = compute["moe_intrain_rate_tflops"] * 1e9
+        routed = float(total) / cp
+        if routed < 16384:
+            lut = compute["moe_rate_lut"]
+            xs, ys = lut["tokens"], lut["tflops"]
+            tokens, offline_rate = max(routed, xs[0]), ys[-1]
+            for index in range(len(xs) - 1):
+                if tokens <= xs[index + 1]:
+                    fraction = (math.log(tokens) - math.log(xs[index])) / (
+                        math.log(xs[index + 1]) - math.log(xs[index])
+                    )
+                    offline_rate = ys[index] + fraction * (ys[index + 1] - ys[index])
+                    break
+            rate *= offline_rate / ys[-1]
+        # Upstream synthetic shape: 24 Q heads / U8, head_dim=160, 44 layers.
+        fa_flops = 44 * 4.0 * 3 * 160 * float(squares) / ring_size
+        moe_flops = 44 * (float(total) / cp) * 5.306e8
+        law = compute["fa_additive_law"]
+        gamma_key = {8: "sp8_fa_cache", 16: "sp16_ring", 32: "sp32_ring"}[cp]
+        gamma = self.table["global"]["gamma_comp"]["pure_compute"][gamma_key]
+        compute_f = gamma["fwd"] * (fa_flops / (law["fwd"]["P_tflops"] * 1e9) + moe_flops / rate)
+        compute_b = gamma["bwd"] * (
+            2.5 * fa_flops / (law["bwd"]["P_tflops"] * 1e9) + 3.0 * moe_flops / rate
+        )
+        a2a = self.table["a2a"]
+        nbytes = 24 * 160 * 2 * (float(total) / cp)
+        invocation = 3 * self._curve(a2a["fits"]["U8_pre"], nbytes) + self._curve(
+            a2a["fits"]["U8_post"], nbytes
+        )
+        inflation = a2a["in_train_inflation_by_tier"][mode]
+        # Defaults: all 44 layers replay; FA cache on; four backward chunks.
+        a2a_f, a2a_b = 44 * invocation * inflation, 88 * invocation * inflation
+        ring_f = ring_b = 0.0
+        if ring_size > 1:
+            ring = self.table["ring"]
+            hop_bytes = 1920 * float(total) / ring_size
+            chunk_bytes = hop_bytes / 4
+            beta = sorted(
+                (float(key[:-2]) * 1e6, float(value))
+                for key, value in ring["beta_by_chunk_bytes"].items()
+                if key.endswith("MB")
+            )
+            amplification = min(beta, key=lambda pair: abs(math.log(pair[0] / chunk_bytes)))[1]
+            dkv = ring["fits"]["dkv"]
+            ring_b = (
+                44 * 4 * (amplification * (dkv["t0_ms"] + chunk_bytes / 1e6 / dkv["bw_gbps"]) / 4)
+            )
+            if ring_size >= 4:
+                kv = ring["fits"]["kv"]
+                ring_f = 0.87 * (kv["t0_ms"] + hop_bytes / 1e6 / kv["bw_gbps"]) * 44
+        result = dict(
+            compute_ms=compute_f + compute_b,
+            a2a_ms=132 * invocation * inflation,
+            ring_ms=ring_b + ring_f,
+            forward_ms=compute_f + a2a_f + ring_f,
+            backward_ms=compute_b + a2a_b + ring_b,
+        )
+        if any(not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0 for value in result.values()):
+            raise ValueError("Invalid DynamicUSP cost prediction")
+        return result
+
+    def forward(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None):
+        """Return the upstream proxy mean forward time per synthetic layer."""
+        return self.components(tuple(lengths), cp)["forward_ms"] / self.layer_count
+
+    def backward(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None):
+        """Return the upstream proxy mean backward time per synthetic layer."""
+        return self.components(tuple(lengths), cp)["backward_ms"] / self.layer_count
+
+    def program_costs(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None):
+        """Return named forward/backward block costs for the timeline."""
+        return dict(block_f=self.forward(lengths, cp), block_b=self.backward(lengths, cp))
+
+    def timing(self):
+        """Describe the upstream block program and global iteration-tail constant."""
+        return dict(
+            iteration_tail_ms=self.table["global"]["C_global_clean_ms"],
+            execution_program=[
+                dict(
+                    layer_count=self.layer_count,
+                    forward=[dict(sync="cp", cost="block_f")] * self.layer_count,
+                    backward=[dict(sync="cp", cost="block_b")] * self.layer_count,
+                )
+            ],
+        )
+
+    def clear(self):
+        """Clear memoized upstream component costs before a new global batch."""
+        self.components.cache_clear()
+
+    def metadata(self):
+        """Record the original U8 calibration and provisional P2P transfer scope."""
+        return dict(
+            name=self.name,
+            source_commit="1ff97a4ae0beb5e088fadb9e112265bdd194b24d",
+            source_hashes=self.source_hashes,
+            provisional=True,
+            modeled_transport="U8 all-to-all + ring",
+            execution_transport="unchanged; native P2P in the temporary recipe",
+            shape="upstream synthetic 44-layer shape, not a Qwen calibration",
+        )
