+                used = storage[cp][anchor]
+                if used > self.geometry.capacity(cp):
+                    continue
+                ids, _ = self._fill_pack(anchor, pending, cp, storage)
+                values = tuple(lengths[i] for i in ids)
+                useful = sum(values)
+                key = self._group_work(values, cp) / useful, -useful, cp
+                if best is None or key < best[0]:
+                    best = key, cp, ids
+            if best is None:
+                return None
+            _, cp, ids = best
+            chosen = set(ids)
+            pending = [i for i in pending if i not in chosen]
+            groups.append(dict(cp=cp, sample_ids=ids))
+        return self._tile(groups, lengths, widths, cost_aware=True)
+
+    def _pack(self, lengths, floor, tables=None):
+        pending = sorted(lengths, key=lambda i: (-lengths[i], i))
+        rounds = []
+        world = self.geometry.world_size
+        allowed = sorted(self.geometry.allowed_cp_sizes)
+        minimums, storage = tables or self._packing_tables(lengths)
+        while pending:
+            row, used = [], 0
+            while used < world and pending:
+                eligible = [c for c in allowed if self.geometry.supports_group(used, c)]
+                anchor = next((i for i in pending if any(minimums[i] <= c for c in eligible)), None)
+                if anchor is None:
+                    break
+                cp_min = minimums[anchor]
+                cp = next((c for c in eligible if max(cp_min, floor) <= c), None)
+                if cp is None:
+                    cp = max(c for c in eligible if cp_min <= c)
+                ids, _ = self._fill_pack(anchor, pending, cp, storage)
+                chosen = set(ids)
+                pending = [i for i in pending if i not in chosen]
+                row.append(dict(cp=cp, sample_ids=ids))
+                used += cp
+            if not row:
+                raise RuntimeScheduleError("no sequence fits the configured capacity")
+            if used < world:
+                # Exact-fill expansion, including non-power-of-two allowed domains.
+                expanded = self._expand(row, lengths)
+                if expanded is None:
+                    # A full-world pack remains feasible; leave unconsumed samples pending.
+                    ids = row[0]["sample_ids"]
+                    for group in row[1:]:
+                        pending.extend(group["sample_ids"])
+                    if world not in allowed:
+                        raise RuntimeScheduleError("allowed CP widths cannot fill every rank")
+                    row = [dict(cp=world, sample_ids=ids)]
+                    pending.sort(key=lambda i: (-lengths[i], i))
+                else:
+                    row = expanded
+            rounds.append(row)
+        return rounds
+
+    def _guide(self, rounds, lengths):
+        # Candidate ordering only; acceptance ALWAYS uses exact injected E2E costs.
+        guide = getattr(self.model, "guide_program_costs", None)
+        if guide is not None and self.timeline.program is not None:
+            return self.timeline.evaluate(self._costed(rounds, lengths, guide)), len(rounds)
+        work = sum(
+            sum(lengths[i] ** 2 for i in g["sample_ids"]) / g["cp"] for row in rounds for g in row
+        )
+        return len(rounds), work
+
+    def _work_guide(self, rounds, lengths):
+        # Intrinsic rank-load lower bound; waiting is added by the full guide.
+        loads = [0.0] * self.geometry.world_size
+        for row in rounds:
+            start = 0
+            for group in row:
+                cp = group["cp"]
+                duration = self._group_work(tuple(lengths[i] for i in group["sample_ids"]), cp) / cp
+                for rank in range(start, start + cp):
+                    loads[rank] += duration
+                start += cp
+        return max(loads), sum(loads), len(rounds)
+
+    def _balance_exact(self, rounds, lengths):
+        """One cyclic-rotation sweep, reusing placement-invariant exact pack costs."""
+        if not getattr(self.model, "placement_invariant", False):
+            return rounds, None, 0
+        costed = self._costed(rounds, lengths)
+        state = self.timeline.initial_state()
+        balanced, changed = [], 0
+        for index, (row, priced) in enumerate(zip(rounds, costed)):
+            best = None
+            for offset in range(len(row)):
+                rotated = priced[offset:] + priced[:offset]
+                start, shifted = 0, []
+                for group in rotated:
+                    if not self.geometry.supports_group(start, group[1]):
+                        break
+                    shifted.append((start, *group[1:]))
+                    start += group[1]
+                if len(shifted) != len(rotated):
+                    continue
+                next_state = self.timeline.advance(state, shifted, index == 0)
+                key = max(next_state), sum(next_state), sum(v * v for v in next_state)
+                if best is None or key < best[0]:
+                    best = key, next_state, offset
+            if best is None:
+                raise RuntimeScheduleError("no supported group placement in rotation candidates")
+            _, state, offset = best
+            balanced.append(row[offset:] + row[:offset])
+            changed += offset != 0
+        return balanced, self.timeline.makespan(state), changed
+
+    def plan(self, lengths, *, incumbent_rounds=None):
+        begin = time.perf_counter()
+        lengths = self._start_plan(lengths)
+        tables = self._packing_tables(lengths)
+        candidates, seen, rejected = [], set(), []
+        for floor in self.options.cp_floors:
+            if floor > self.geometry.world_size:
+                continue
+            try:
+                proposals = [self._pack(lengths, floor, tables)]
+            except RuntimeScheduleError as exc:
+                rejected.append(str(exc))
+                proposals = []
+            if floor in (1, 4, 8, 16, 32):
+                proposals.append(self._global_pack(lengths, floor, tables=tables))
+            if floor == 1:
+                proposals.extend(
+                    self._global_pack(lengths, floor, extra, tables) for extra in (1, 2, 4)
+                )
+            for rounds in proposals:
+                if rounds is None:
+                    continue
+                signature = tuple(
+                    tuple((g["cp"], tuple(g["sample_ids"])) for g in row) for row in rounds
+                )
+                if signature not in seen:
+                    seen.add(signature)
+                    candidates.append(rounds)
+        for ep_aligned in (False, True):
+            rounds = self._cost_pack(lengths, tables, ep_aligned)
+            if rounds is not None:
+                signature = tuple(
+                    tuple((g["cp"], tuple(g["sample_ids"])) for g in row) for row in rounds
+                )
+                if signature not in seen:
+                    seen.add(signature)
+                    candidates.append(rounds)
+        generated = len(candidates)
+        # The slowest rank, not total GPU work, drives the cheap shortlist.
+        candidates.sort(key=lambda rounds: self._work_guide(rounds, lengths))
+        candidates = candidates[: self.options.max_guide_candidates]
+        candidates.sort(key=lambda rounds: self._guide(rounds, lengths))
+        if incumbent_rounds is not None:
+            validate_rows(
+                encode_rows(incumbent_rounds, self.geometry.world_size),
+                lengths,
+                self.geometry,
+                min(self.geometry.allowed_cp_sizes),

+        if not candidates:
+            raise RuntimeScheduleError(
+                "runtime heuristics could not produce an exact-width row; "
+                "this is not an infeasibility proof"
+            )
+        best, scored, attempted, selected = None, 0, 0, None
+        previous_score_s = 0.0
+        generation_s = time.perf_counter() - begin
+        mandatory = (
+            2 if incumbent_rounds is not None and self.options.max_scored_candidates > 1 else 1
+        )
+        for index, rounds in enumerate(candidates):
+            if attempted >= mandatory and (
+                attempted >= self.options.max_scored_candidates

+            candidate_generation_s=generation_s,
+            exact_scoring_s=elapsed - generation_s - balance_s,

+            algorithm=(

+from __future__ import annotations

+import time

+
+class RuntimeScheduleError(RuntimeError):
+    """Invalid runtime schedule; every Megatron rank raises the same error."""
+
+
+def _ceil_to(value: int, unit: int) -> int:
+    return (int(value) + unit - 1) // unit * unit
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RuntimePlanGeometry:
+    """Static geometry of the DPxCP domain; also the ``config`` object PackCostModel expects."""
+
+    world_size: int
+    tokens_per_rank: int
+    ep_size: int
+    allowed_cp_sizes: Tuple[int, ...]
+    dataset_alignment: int
+    max_group_seqs: Optional[int] = None
+    align_group_starts: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        if self.world_size < 1 or self.tokens_per_rank < 1:
+            raise ValueError("world_size and tokens_per_rank must be >= 1")
+        if self.ep_size < 1 or self.world_size % self.ep_size:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"expert_model_parallel_size ({self.ep_size}) must divide "
+                f"dp_size*cp_size ({self.world_size})"
+            )
+        if not self.allowed_cp_sizes or any(
+            not 1 <= cp <= self.world_size for cp in self.allowed_cp_sizes
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"allowed_cp_sizes must be within 1..{self.world_size}: {self.allowed_cp_sizes}"
+            )
+        if self.dataset_alignment < 1 or self.dataset_alignment % 2:
+            raise ValueError("dataset_alignment must be a positive even number")
+        if self.max_group_seqs is not None and self.max_group_seqs < 1:
+            raise ValueError("max_group_seqs must be >= 1 when set")
+
+    def stored_length(self, length: int, cp: int) -> int:
+        """Physical tokens after dataset alignment and CP re-padding by _pack_sequences."""
+        aligned = _ceil_to(int(length), self.dataset_alignment)
+        return _ceil_to(aligned, 2 * int(cp))
+
+    def capacity(self, cp: int) -> int:
+        """Physical tokens of a CP-``cp`` microbatch pack."""
+        return int(cp) * self.tokens_per_rank
+
+    def supports_group(self, start: int, cp: int) -> bool:
+        """Whether this contiguous interval is supported by the runtime's groups."""
+        return (
+            cp in self.allowed_cp_sizes
+            and 0 <= start <= self.world_size - cp
+            and (not self.align_group_starts or start % cp == 0)
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class RuntimePlan:
+    """One planned global batch (rows are what MCore consumes; the rest is telemetry)."""
+
+    rows: List[List[List[int]]]
+    groups: List[List[Tuple[int, int, List[int]]]]
+    predicted_ms: float
+    planning_s: float
+    microbatches: int
+    dummy_tokens: List[List[int]] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+def encode_rows(rounds, world_size: int) -> List[List[List[int]]]:
+    """``sched`` rounds (``[[{'cp', 'sample_ids'}]]``) -> MCore rows (``[mb][rank] -> ids``)."""
+    rows = []
+    for row in rounds:
+        encoded = [list(group["sample_ids"]) for group in row for _ in range(int(group["cp"]))]
+        if len(encoded) != world_size:
+            raise RuntimeScheduleError(
+                f"scheduler row covers {len(encoded)} ranks, expected {world_size}: "
+                f"{[(g['cp'], len(g['sample_ids'])) for g in row]}"
+            )
+        rows.append(encoded)
+    return rows
+
+
+def decode_groups(row: Sequence[Sequence[int]]) -> List[Tuple[int, int, List[int]]]:
+    """One MCore row -> ``[(start, cp, ids)]`` (maximal runs of equal id lists, rank order)."""
+    groups = []
+    first = 0
+    n = len(row)
+    while first < n:
+        ids = list(row[first])
+        end = first + 1
+        while end < n and list(row[end]) == ids:
+            end += 1
+        groups.append((first, end - first, ids))
+        first = end
+    return groups
+
+
+def validate_rows(
+    rows: Sequence[Sequence[Sequence[int]]],
+    lengths: Dict[int, int],
+    geometry: RuntimePlanGeometry,
+    min_cp_size: int,
+) -> List[List[Tuple[int, int, List[int]]]]:
+    """Check every invariant MCore relies on; return the decoded groups per microbatch.
+
+    Raises :class:`RuntimeScheduleError` naming the microbatch, rank and reason before an
+    IndexError / assert deep inside ``build_packed_microbatches``.
+    """
+    if not rows:
+        raise RuntimeScheduleError("runtime scheduler produced no microbatch")
+    world = geometry.world_size
+    allowed = set(geometry.allowed_cp_sizes)
+    seen: List[int] = []
+    decoded = []
+    for m, row in enumerate(rows):
+        if len(row) != world:
+            raise RuntimeScheduleError(
+                f"microbatch {m}: row has {len(row)} rank entries, expected {world}"
+            )
+        groups = decode_groups(row)
+        for start, cp, ids in groups:
+            if not ids:
+                raise RuntimeScheduleError(
+                    f"microbatch {m}: rank {start} has no sequence (every rank must pack >= 1)"
+                )
+            if cp not in allowed or cp < min_cp_size:
+                raise RuntimeScheduleError(
+                    f"microbatch {m}: group at rank {start} has cp={cp}, allowed {sorted(allowed)} "
+                    f"and min_dynamic_context_parallel_size={min_cp_size}"
+                )
+            if not geometry.supports_group(start, cp):
+                raise RuntimeScheduleError(
+                    f"microbatch {m}: cp={cp} group at rank {start} requires a size-aligned start"
+                )
+            if geometry.max_group_seqs is not None and len(ids) > geometry.max_group_seqs:
+                raise RuntimeScheduleError(
+                    f"microbatch {m}: group at rank {start} packs {len(ids)} sequences, "
+                    f"cap is {geometry.max_group_seqs} (thd_max_packed_sequences)"
+                )
+            stored = 0
+            for i in ids:
+                if i not in lengths:
+                    raise RuntimeScheduleError(
+                        f"microbatch {m}: unknown sample id {i} at rank {start}"
+                    )
+                stored += geometry.stored_length(lengths[i], cp)
+            if stored > geometry.capacity(cp):
+                raise RuntimeScheduleError(
+                    f"microbatch {m}: group at rank {start} (cp={cp}) stores {stored} tokens, "
+                    f"capacity {geometry.capacity(cp)}"
+                )
+            seen.extend(ids)
+        # Equal-list runs are contiguous by construction. The multiset check below catches
+        # any ID appearing in two non-adjacent groups as a duplicate.
+        decoded.append(groups)
+    if sorted(seen) != sorted(lengths):
+        counts: Dict[int, int] = {}
+        for i in seen:
+            counts[i] = counts.get(i, 0) + 1
+        missing = sorted(i for i in lengths if i not in counts)
+        extra = sorted(i for i, c in counts.items() if c > 1 or i not in lengths)
+        raise RuntimeScheduleError(
+            f"schedule lost or duplicated samples: missing {missing}, duplicated/unknown {extra}"
+        )
+    return decoded
+
+
+def dummy_tokens_per_group(
+    groups, lengths: Dict[int, int], geometry: RuntimePlanGeometry
+) -> List[List[int]]:
+    """Padding MCore materialises per group under pad 'max' + append_dummy_seq (telemetry)."""
+    return [
+        [
+            geometry.capacity(cp) - sum(geometry.stored_length(lengths[i], cp) for i in ids)
+            for _, cp, ids in row
+        ]
+        for row in groups
+    ]
+
+
+class RuntimePlanner(ABC):
+    """Common model injection, validation, pricing and rank-row contract for both solvers."""
+
+    def __init__(self, geometry, cost_model) -> None:
+        geometry = replace(geometry, allowed_cp_sizes=tuple(sorted(set(geometry.allowed_cp_sizes))))
+        self.geometry = geometry
+        self.model = cost_model
+        cost_model.check_domain(geometry, None)
+        self.timeline = build_timeline(cost_model, geometry)
+        prepare = getattr(cost_model, "prepare_guide", None)
+        if prepare is not None:
+            prepare(geometry.allowed_cp_sizes)
+        self.costs = self._new_costs()
+        self.last_statistics = {}
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def plan(self, lengths, *, incumbent_rounds=None):
+        """Search with the injected cost model and return a validated RuntimePlan."""
+
+    def _new_costs(self):
+        return PackCostModel(
+            self.geometry,
+            self.model.forward,
+            self.model.backward,
+            getattr(self.model, "program_costs", None),
+            placement_period=(
+                None
+                if getattr(self.model, "placement_invariant", False)
+                else self.geometry.world_size
+            ),
+            max_group_seqs=self.geometry.max_group_seqs or 64,
+        )
+
+    def _start_plan(self, lengths):
+        lengths = dict(lengths)
+        if not lengths or any(
+            type(i) is not int or i < 0 or type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for i, n in lengths.items()
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "lengths must map nonnegative integer IDs to positive integer logical lengths"
+            )
+        self.model.clear()
+        self.costs = self._new_costs()
+        return lengths
+
+    def _make_plan(self, rounds, lengths, predicted, begin):
+        rows = encode_rows(rounds, self.geometry.world_size)
+        groups = validate_rows(rows, lengths, self.geometry, min(self.geometry.allowed_cp_sizes))
+        return RuntimePlan(
+            rows=rows,
+            groups=groups,
+            predicted_ms=predicted,
+            planning_s=time.perf_counter() - begin,
+            microbatches=len(rows),
+            dummy_tokens=dummy_tokens_per_group(groups, lengths, self.geometry),
+        )
+
+    def _costed(self, rounds, lengths, guide=None):
+        out = []
+        for row in rounds:
+            start, groups = 0, []
+            for group in row:
+                cp = group["cp"]
+                values = tuple(lengths[i] for i in group["sample_ids"])
+                value = (
+                    (0.0, 0.0, guide(values, cp, ranks=tuple(range(start, start + cp))))
+                    if guide is not None
+                    else self.costs.pack(values, cp, start)
+                )
+                if value is None:
+                    raise RuntimeScheduleError(f"cost model rejected CP{cp} pack {values}")
+                groups.append((start, cp, *value))
+                start += cp
+            out.append(groups)
+        return out
+
+    def plan_padded(self, padded_lengths, *, logical_lengths=None, incumbent_rows=None):
+        """MCore input [(global_sample_id, dataset-padded length)]; pure CPU.
+
+        No LM shift is inferred. Exact logical lengths are optional and must ceil
+        to the supplied padded lengths. Otherwise the cost input is explicitly
+        the padded upper bound, not fabricated logical lengths.
+        """
+        items = list(padded_lengths.items() if hasattr(padded_lengths, "items") else padded_lengths)
+        padded = dict(items)
+        if (
+            len(padded) != len(items)
+            or not padded
+            or any(
+                type(i) is not int
+                or i < 0
+                or type(n) is not int
+                or n <= 0
+                or n % self.geometry.dataset_alignment
+                for i, n in items
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("unique nonnegative IDs and dataset-aligned positive lengths required")
+        logical = padded if logical_lengths is None else dict(logical_lengths)
+        if logical.keys() != padded.keys() or any(
+            type(n) is not int
+            or n <= 0
+            or (n + self.geometry.dataset_alignment - 1)
+            // self.geometry.dataset_alignment
+            * self.geometry.dataset_alignment
+            != padded[i]
+            for i, n in logical.items()
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "logical lengths must match every padded input after dataset alignment"
+            )
+        incumbent = None
+        if incumbent_rows is not None:
+            groups = validate_rows(
+                incumbent_rows, padded, self.geometry, min(self.geometry.allowed_cp_sizes)
+            )
+            incumbent = [[dict(cp=cp, sample_ids=ids) for _, cp, ids in row] for row in groups]
+        plan = self.plan(logical, incumbent_rounds=incumbent)
+        validate_rows(plan.rows, padded, self.geometry, min(self.geometry.allowed_cp_sizes))
+        self.last_statistics["cost_length_source"] = (
+            "after_lm_logical" if logical_lengths is not None else "dataset_padded_upper_bound"
+        )
+        return plan

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TimelineModel:
+    """Simulate CP/EP synchronization dependencies across a complete training step."""
+
+    world_size: int
+    ep_size: int
+    layer_count: int
+    forward_non_attention_ms: float = 0.0
+    backward_non_attention_ms: float = 0.0
+    iteration_tail_ms: float = 0.0
+    first_forward_dp_cp_sync: bool = True
+    program: tuple | None = None  # (forward_ops, backward_ops) for program mode
+
+    @property
+    def blocks(self):
+        """Return the number of expert-parallel blocks in the parent domain."""
+        return self.world_size // self.ep_size
+
+    @property
+    def scalar(self):
+        """Indicate whether timing uses scalar forward/backward costs."""
+        return self.program is None
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ state
+    def initial_state(self):
+        """Initialize completion times for each modeled block or rank."""
+        n = self.blocks if self.scalar else self.world_size
+        return [0.0] * n
+
+    def makespan(self, state):
+        """Return step completion time including the configured iteration tail."""
+        return max(state) + self.iteration_tail_ms
+
+    def advance(self, state, groups: Sequence[tuple], first: bool):
+        """Apply one microbatch (forward then backward) to a state; returns the new state."""
+        if self.scalar:
+            state = self._scalar_phase(state, groups, 0)
+            if first and self.first_forward_dp_cp_sync:
+                m = max(state)
+                state = [m] * len(state)
+            return self._scalar_phase(state, groups, 1)
+        state = self._program_phase(state, groups, self.program[0])
+        if first and self.first_forward_dp_cp_sync:
+            m = max(state)
+            state = [m] * len(state)
+        return self._program_phase(state, groups, self.program[1])
+
+    def evaluate(self, rounds: Sequence[Sequence[tuple]]):
+        """Score all microbatches with the shared forward/backward timeline."""
+        state = self.initial_state()
+        for index, groups in enumerate(rounds):
+            state = self.advance(state, groups, index == 0)
+        return self.makespan(state)
+
+    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- scalar
+    def _scalar_phase(self, state, groups, phase):
+        e = self.ep_size
+        na = self.forward_non_attention_ms if phase == 0 else self.backward_non_attention_ms
+        spans = []
+        for g in groups:
+            start, cp = g[0], g[1]
+            b0, b1 = start // e, (start + cp - 1) // e
+            spans.append((b0, b1 + 1, g[2 + phase] + na))
+        t = list(state)
+        nb = len(t)
+        layers = self.layer_count
+        done = 0
+        while done < layers:
+            new = [float('-inf')] * nb
+            for b0, b1, cost in spans:
+                s = max(t[b0:b1]) + cost
+                for b in range(b0, b1):
+                    if s > new[b]:
+                        new[b] = s
+            done += 1
+            delta = [a - b for a, b in zip(new, t)]
+            t = new
+            if done < layers and all(d == delta[0] for d in delta):
+                # Every block advanced by the same amount, so the relative offsets are
+                # unchanged and the max-plus recurrence repeats this step exactly.
+                t = [v + (layers - done) * delta[0] for v in t]
+                break
+        return t
+
+    # --------------------------------------------------------------- program
+    def _program_phase(self, state, groups, ops):
+        w, e = self.world_size, self.ep_size
+        t = list(state)
+        for kind, payload in ops:
+            if kind == 'local':
+                t = [v + payload for v in t]
+            elif kind == 'ep':
+                for s in range(0, w, e):
+                    m = max(t[s : s + e]) + payload
+                    t[s : s + e] = [m] * e
+            else:  # 'cp' with named cost
+                for g in groups:
+                    start, cp = g[0], g[1]
+                    m = max(t[start : start + cp]) + g[4][payload]
+                    t[start : start + cp] = [m] * cp
+        return t
+
+
+def _freeze_op(op):
+    if "cost" in op:
+        return ("cp", op["cost"])
+    return (op["sync"], float(op["duration_ms"]))
+
+
+def build_timeline(model, geometry: "RuntimePlanGeometry") -> TimelineModel:
+    """Program-mode timeline from ``model.timing()`` or a scalar timeline when it is None."""
+    timing = model.timing()
+    if timing is None:
+        return TimelineModel(
+            geometry.world_size,
+            geometry.ep_size,
+            int(getattr(model, "layer_count", 1)),
+            float(getattr(model, "forward_non_attention_ms", 0.0)),
+            float(getattr(model, "backward_non_attention_ms", 0.0)),
+            0.0,
+            True,
+            None,
+        )
+    programs = timing["execution_program"]
+    if len(programs) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("program mode supports one virtual stage (PP1/VPP1)")
+    program = programs[0]
+    ops = (
+        tuple(_freeze_op(op) for op in program["forward"]),
+        tuple(_freeze_op(op) for op in program["backward"]),
+    )
+    return TimelineModel(
+        geometry.world_size,
+        geometry.ep_size,
+        int(program["layer_count"]),
+        0.0,
+        0.0,
+        float(timing.get("iteration_tail_ms", 0.0)),
+        True,
+        ops,
+    )

+"""CPU-only DCP worker, executed by file path without importing Megatron or TE."""
+
+import importlib
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+import traceback
+from dataclasses import asdict, is_dataclass
+
+
+def _runtime_module(name):
+    prefix = f'{__package__}.' if __package__ else ''
+    return importlib.import_module(f'{prefix}dcp_runtime_scheduler.{name}')
+
+
+class _AttentionWorkModel:
+    """Quadratic-work smoke-test proxy, not a calibrated GPU timing prediction."""
+
+    name = 'megatron_quadratic_work'
+    source_hashes = {'model': 'sum(stored_length**2)/cp'}
+    program_costs = None
+    layer_count = 1
+    forward_non_attention_ms = 0.0
+    backward_non_attention_ms = 0.0
+    placement_invariant = True
+
+    def __init__(self, geometry):
+        self.geometry = geometry
+
+    def forward(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None):
+        """Estimate per-layer forward milliseconds from padded quadratic attention work."""
+        return sum(self.geometry.stored_length(length, cp) ** 2 for length in lengths) / cp / 1e6
+
+    def backward(self, lengths, cp, *, ranks=None):
+        """Estimate per-layer backward milliseconds for the quadratic work proxy."""
+        return 2 * self.forward(lengths, cp, ranks=ranks)
+
+    def timing(self):
+        """Use the shared scalar timeline for the quadratic work proxy."""
+        return None
+
+    def clear(self):
+        """Accept the cache-reset hook for this stateless work proxy."""
+        return None
+
+    def check_domain(self, geometry, config):
+        """Accept the validated planner geometry for this geometry-only proxy."""
+        return None
+
+
+def _initialize_planner(spec):
+    geometry_options = dict(spec['geometry'])
+    geometry_options['allowed_cp_sizes'] = tuple(sorted(set(geometry_options['allowed_cp_sizes'])))
+    geometry = _runtime_module('runtime.planner').RuntimePlanGeometry(**geometry_options)
+    if spec['default_model']:
+        model = _AttentionWorkModel(geometry=geometry, **spec['model_options'])
+    elif spec['model'] in (
+        'calibrated_attention',
+        'usp_calib_v1',
+        'qwen35_gb200',
+        'dcp_scheduler.adapters:qwen35_new_core_model',
+    ):
+        model = _runtime_module('models').make_model(
+            spec['model'], geometry, **spec['model_options']
+        )
+    else:
+        module, factory = spec['model'].split(':', 1)
+        model = getattr(importlib.import_module(module), factory)(**spec['model_options'])
+    options = spec.get('solver_options', {})
+    if spec.get('solver') == 'dynamic_usp':
+        return _runtime_module('runtime.dynamic_usp').DynamicUSPRuntimePlanner(
+            geometry, model, **options
+        )
+    if spec.get('solver'):
+        module, factory = spec['solver'].split(':', 1)
+        return getattr(importlib.import_module(module), factory)(geometry, model, **options)
+    runtime = _runtime_module('runtime.lightweight')
+    return runtime.LightweightRuntimePlanner(geometry, model, runtime.LightweightOptions(**options))
+
+
+def _solve(planner, spec, lengths, padded, baseline_rows):
+    validate_rows = _runtime_module('runtime.planner').validate_rows
+
+    started = {'monotonic_ns': time.monotonic_ns(), 'wall_ns': time.time_ns()}
+    alignment = planner.geometry.dataset_alignment
+    if len(lengths) != len(padded) or any(
+        ((length + alignment - 1) // alignment) * alignment != physical
+        for length, physical in zip(lengths, padded)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError('Runtime DCP requires lengths matching the dataset padding alignment')
+    logical = dict(enumerate(lengths))
+    if spec['force_powers']:
+        groups = validate_rows(
+            baseline_rows,
+            dict(enumerate(padded)),
+            planner.geometry,
+            min(planner.geometry.allowed_cp_sizes),
+        )
+        if any(cp & (cp - 1) for row in groups for _, cp, _ in row):
+            raise ValueError('The P2 comparison baseline contains a non-power-of-two group')
+        rows, statistics, predicted_ms = baseline_rows, {'powers_baseline': True}, None
+    else:
+        plan = planner.plan_padded(
+            dict(enumerate(padded)), logical_lengths=logical, incumbent_rows=baseline_rows
+        )
+        rows, statistics, predicted_ms = plan.rows, planner.last_statistics, plan.predicted_ms
+    metadata = getattr(planner.model, 'metadata', None)
+    model_metadata = metadata() if callable(metadata) else None
+    torch = sys.modules.get('torch')
+    cuda_initialized = bool(torch is not None and torch.cuda.is_initialized())
+    distributed_initialized = bool(torch is not None and torch.distributed.is_initialized())
+    if cuda_initialized or distributed_initialized:
+        raise RuntimeError('CPU predictor must not initialize CUDA or distributed')
+    return dict(
+        rows=rows,
+        statistics=statistics,
+        predicted_ms=predicted_ms,
+        model_metadata=model_metadata,
+        planner_options=(
+            asdict(planner.options)
+            if is_dataclass(getattr(planner, 'options', None))
+            else spec.get('solver_options', {})
+        ),
+        solver_entry=(
+            spec['solver']
+            if spec.get('solver') and ':' in spec['solver']
+            else f'{type(planner).__module__}:{type(planner).__name__}'
+        )
+        + '.plan_padded',
+        solve_start=started,
+        solve_end={'monotonic_ns': time.monotonic_ns(), 'wall_ns': time.time_ns()},
+        worker_pid=os.getpid(),
+        worker_cuda_initialized=cuda_initialized,
+        worker_distributed_initialized=distributed_initialized,
+        external_scheduler_imported=any(
+            name == 'dcp_scheduler' or name.startswith('dcp_scheduler.') for name in sys.modules
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    # Keep third-party diagnostics out of the JSON protocol, which uses stdout.
+    """Serve newline-delimited CPU planner requests over standard input/output."""
+    output = sys.stdout
+    sys.stdout = sys.stderr
+    try:
+        spec = json.loads(sys.stdin.readline())
+        planner = _initialize_planner(spec)
+        for request in sys.stdin:
+            try:
+                result = _solve(planner, spec, *json.loads(request))
+            except Exception:
+                result = {'error': traceback.format_exc()}
+            output.write(json.dumps(result) + '\n')
+            output.flush()
+    except Exception:
+        output.write(json.dumps({'error': traceback.format_exc()}) + '\n')
+        output.flush()
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""One-batch lookahead for a CPU-only, leader-owned DCP planner."""
+
+import atexit
+import hashlib
+import importlib
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+import traceback
+from collections import deque
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core.datasets.data_schedule_utils import get_batch_and_global_seqlens
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from megatron.core.model_parallel_config import ModelParallelConfig
+    from megatron.core.rerun_state_machine import RerunDataIterator
+
+
+class _CpuPlanner:
+    """Isolated executable: never re-import the GPU training entry point via spawn."""
+
+    def __init__(self, spec: dict) -> None:
+        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
+            [sys.executable, '-u', str(Path(__file__).with_name('dcp_runtime_worker.py'))],
+            env={
+                **os.environ,
+                'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES': '',
+                'OMP_NUM_THREADS': '1',
+                'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS': '1',
+            },
+            stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
+            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+            text=True,
+            bufsize=1,
+        )
+        self.process.stdin.write(json.dumps(spec) + '\n')
+        self.process.stdin.flush()
+
+    def solve(self, lengths: list[int], padded: list[int], baseline_rows: list) -> dict:
+        # This method runs in an I/O-only thread; the separate process solves.
+        """Send one global batch to the isolated worker and return its result or error."""
+        try:
+            self.process.stdin.write(json.dumps([lengths, padded, baseline_rows]) + '\n')
+            self.process.stdin.flush()
+        except BrokenPipeError:
+            # Initialization failures already wrote an error response before exiting.
+            pass
+        response = self.process.stdout.readline()
+        if not response:
+            raise RuntimeError(f'CPU DCP worker exited unexpectedly: {self.process.poll()}')
+        payload = json.loads(response)
+        if 'error' in payload:
+            raise RuntimeError(payload['error'])
+        return payload
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        """Close the request stream and reap the CPU worker process."""
+        try:
+            self.process.stdin.close()
+        except BrokenPipeError:
+            pass
+        self.process.wait()
+        self.process.stdout.close()
+
+
+class _BufferedIterator:
+    def __init__(self, source):
+        self.source = source
+        self.items = deque()
+
+    def __iter__(self):
+        return self
+
+    def __next__(self):
+        return self.items.popleft() if self.items else next(self.source)
+
+    def peek(self, count):
+        """Buffer upcoming items without advancing the owning rerun iterator."""
+        while len(self.items) < count:
+            self.items.append(next(self.source))
+        return list(self.items)[:count]
+
+
+class DcpSchedulePrefetcher:
+    """Prepare one future batch without consuming the rerun iterator early.
+
+    Only the owning training process reads data and calls distributed/CUDA APIs.
+    One isolated CPU worker, on the DPxCP leader only, owns the persistent planner.
+    The global length collective is moved earlier, not duplicated or threaded.
+
+    Args:
+        data_iterator: Original RerunDataIterator.
+        dp_group: Existing data-parallel process group.
+        dp_cp_group: Existing data/context-parallel process group.
+        spec: Pickleable CPU planner specification; contains no tensors or groups.
+        asynchronous: Whether to prepare and solve one batch ahead.
+        trace_dir: Optional per-rank JSONL output directory.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        data_iterator: 'RerunDataIterator',
+        dp_group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup,
+        dp_cp_group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup,
+        spec: dict,
+        asynchronous: bool,
+        trace_dir: str | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.iterator = data_iterator
+        self.buffer = _BufferedIterator(data_iterator.iterable)
+        data_iterator.iterable = self.buffer
+        self.dp_group = dp_group
+        self.group = dp_cp_group
+        self.spec = spec
+        self.asynchronous = asynchronous
+        self.pending = None
+        self.sequence_number = 0
+        self.last_telemetry = None
+        self.executor = None
+        self.worker = None
+        self.baseline = None
+        self.trace_path = None
+        if trace_dir:
+            directory = Path(trace_dir)
+            directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            self.trace_path = directory / f'rank{torch.distributed.get_rank():05d}.jsonl'
+        if dp_cp_group.rank() == 0:
+            from megatron.core.datasets.data_schedule import DefaultDynamicCPScheduler
+
+            geometry = spec['geometry']
+            self.baseline = DefaultDynamicCPScheduler(
+                geometry['tokens_per_rank'],
+                geometry['world_size'],
+                1,
+                None,
+                max_num_seqs=geometry['max_group_seqs'],
+                min_cp_size=min(geometry['allowed_cp_sizes']),
+            ).get_groups_and_subsamples
+            if spec.get('baseline'):
+                module, factory = spec['baseline'].split(':', 1)
+                self.baseline = getattr(importlib.import_module(module), factory)(geometry)
+            self.worker = _CpuPlanner(spec)
+            self.executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix='dcp-planner-io')
+        atexit.register(self.close)
+
+    def _submit(self, prepared, count):
+        lengths = prepared[-1]
+        padded = prepared[4]
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([lengths, padded]).encode()).hexdigest()
+        # Construct the configured P2 incumbent, never the arbitrary heuristic.
+        # This cheap incumbent construction remains on the main process; scoring/search
+        # and the predictor's initialization run exclusively in the CPU worker.
+        baseline_rows = self.baseline(list(enumerate(padded))) if self.baseline else None
+        submitted = {'monotonic_ns': time.monotonic_ns(), 'wall_ns': time.time_ns()}
+        future = (
+            self.executor.submit(self.worker.solve, lengths, padded, baseline_rows)
+            if self.executor
+            else None
+        )
+        return dict(prepared=prepared, count=count, future=future, digest=digest, submit=submitted)
+
+    def consume(self, count: int) -> tuple:
+        """Consume this step's raw data and the leader's completed schedule.
+
+        Returns:
+            Original five-field batch metadata tuple and the scheduled rank rows.
+        """
+        begin = time.monotonic_ns()
+        if (
+            self.pending is not None
+            and self.pending['count'] == count
+            and not self.iterator.replaying
+        ):
+            pending = self.pending
+            for _ in range(count):
+                next(self.iterator)
+        else:
+            if self.pending is not None and self.pending['future'] is not None:
+                self.pending['future'].cancel()
+            prepared = get_batch_and_global_seqlens(
+                self.iterator, count, self.dp_group, include_original_seqlens=True
+            )
+            pending = self._submit(prepared, count)
+        self.pending = None
+        payload = [None]
+        waiting = time.monotonic_ns()
+        if self.executor:
+            try:
+                ready = pending['future'].done()
+                result = pending['future'].result()
+                payload[0] = dict(
+                    result=result,
+                    digest=pending['digest'],
+                    ready_when_consumed=ready,
+                    planner_wait_s=(time.monotonic_ns() - waiting) / 1e9,
+                )
+            except Exception:
+                payload[0] = dict(error=traceback.format_exc())
+        torch.distributed.broadcast_object_list(
+            payload,
+            src=torch.distributed.get_global_rank(self.group, 0),
+            group=self.group,
+            device=torch.device('cuda', torch.cuda.current_device()),
+        )
+        consumed = {'monotonic_ns': time.monotonic_ns(), 'wall_ns': time.time_ns()}
+        if 'error' in payload[0]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"CPU DCP planner failed:\n{payload[0]['error']}")
+        mismatch = torch.tensor(
+            [int(payload[0]['digest'] != pending['digest'])], device='cuda', dtype=torch.int32
+        )
+        torch.distributed.all_reduce(mismatch, group=self.group)
+        if mismatch.item():
+            raise RuntimeError('CP replicas disagree on the global logical/physical lengths')
+        result = payload[0]['result']
+        self.last_telemetry = dict(
+            event='consume',
+            sequence_number=self.sequence_number,
+            asynchronous=self.asynchronous,
+            submit=pending['submit'],
+            solve_start=result['solve_start'],
+            solve_end=result['solve_end'],
+            consume=consumed,
+            worker_pid=result['worker_pid'],
+            worker_cuda_initialized=result['worker_cuda_initialized'],
+            worker_distributed_initialized=result['worker_distributed_initialized'],
+            external_scheduler_imported=result.get('external_scheduler_imported', False),
+            input_digest=pending['digest'],
+            global_lengths=pending['prepared'][-1],
+            padded_lengths=pending['prepared'][4],
+            global_ids=list(range(len(pending['prepared'][-1]))),
+            residual_wait_s=payload[0]['planner_wait_s'],
+            plan_receive_s=(consumed['monotonic_ns'] - waiting) / 1e9,
+            ready_when_consumed=payload[0]['ready_when_consumed'],
+            consume_s=(consumed['monotonic_ns'] - begin) / 1e9,
+            queue_depth=0,
+            queue_depth_at_submit=1,
+            predicted_ms=result['predicted_ms'],
+            model_metadata=result.get('model_metadata'),
+            statistics=result['statistics'],
+            rows=result['rows'],
+            solver=self.spec.get('solver'),
+            solver_options=self.spec.get('solver_options', {}),
+            planner_options=result.get('planner_options', self.spec.get('solver_options', {})),
+            solver_entry=result.get('solver_entry'),
+            baseline=self.spec.get('baseline') or 'checkout_default_powers_not_historical_pin',
+        )
+        self._trace(self.last_telemetry)
+        self.sequence_number += 1
+        return pending['prepared'][:5], result['rows']
+
+    def prefetch(self, count: int) -> None:
+        """Prepare one batch and submit its solve before current-step GPU training."""
+        if not self.asynchronous or self.pending is not None:
+            return
+        ended = False
+        try:
+            items = self.buffer.peek(count)
+        except StopIteration:
+            ended = True
+        end_flag = torch.tensor([int(ended)], dtype=torch.int32, device='cuda')
+        torch.distributed.all_reduce(end_flag, group=self.group)
+        if end_flag.item():
+            return
+        prepared = get_batch_and_global_seqlens(
+            iter(items), count, self.dp_group, include_original_seqlens=True
+        )
+        self.pending = self._submit(prepared, count)
+        self._trace(
+            dict(
+                event='submit',
+                sequence_number=self.sequence_number,
+                submit=self.pending['submit'],
+                input_digest=self.pending['digest'],
+                queue_depth=1,
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _trace(self, payload):
+        if self.trace_path:
+            with self.trace_path.open('a') as stream:
+                stream.write(json.dumps(payload) + '\n')
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        """Finish outstanding CPU work; no worker ever accesses a process group."""
+        if self.executor is not None:
+            self.executor.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=True)
+            self.executor = None
+        if self.worker is not None:
+            self.worker.close()
+            self.worker = None
+
+
+def _json_options(options):
+    if isinstance(options, str):
+        options = (
+            json.loads(options)
+            if options.lstrip().startswith('{')
+            else json.loads(Path(options).read_text())
+        )
+    if options is not None and not isinstance(options, dict):
+        raise ValueError('Runtime model/solver options must be a JSON object')
+    return options or {}
+
+
+def runtime_spec(
+    config: 'ModelParallelConfig', world_size: int, *, max_num_seqs: int | None = None
+) -> dict:
+    """Build a CPU-only, serializable planner specification from model configuration."""
+    factory = getattr(config, 'dynamic_cp_runtime_model', None)
+    options = _json_options(getattr(config, 'dynamic_cp_runtime_model_options', None))
+    minimum = config.min_dynamic_context_parallel_size
+    # Classic CP creates canonical, size-aligned power-of-two subgroups.
+    # Restrict candidates, while leaving the selected solver's search enabled.
+    allowed = tuple(
+        cp for cp in range(minimum, world_size + 1) if cp & (cp - 1) == 0 and world_size % cp == 0
+    )
+    if factory == 'usp_calib_v1':
+        if world_size not in (8, 16, 32) or minimum not in (8, 16, 32) or minimum > world_size:
+            raise ValueError('usp_calib_v1 requires DPxCP and minimum CP in (8, 16, 32)')
+        allowed = tuple(cp for cp in (8, 16, 32) if minimum <= cp <= world_size)
+    if minimum not in allowed:
+        raise ValueError('Runtime DCP requires a power-of-two minimum CP dividing DPxCP')
+    return dict(
+        geometry=dict(
+            world_size=world_size,
+            tokens_per_rank=config.max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank,
+            ep_size=getattr(config, 'expert_model_parallel_size', 1),
+            allowed_cp_sizes=allowed,
+            dataset_alignment=2 * world_size,
+            max_group_seqs=min(max_num_seqs, 64) if max_num_seqs is not None else 64,
+            align_group_starts=True,
+        ),
+        model=factory or 'megatron.core.datasets.dcp_runtime_worker:_AttentionWorkModel',
+        model_options=options,
+        solver=getattr(config, 'dynamic_cp_runtime_solver', None),
+        solver_options=_json_options(getattr(config, 'dynamic_cp_runtime_solver_options', None)),

+_COST = (1024.0, 2304.0)

+def _groups(layout):
+    return [(list(samples), len(list(ranks))) for samples, ranks in groupby(layout)]
+
+
+def _local_length(length, cp_size, sp_size=1):
+    alignment = cp_size * lcm(2 if cp_size > 1 else 1, sp_size)
+    return ceil(length / alignment) * alignment // cp_size
+
+
+def _layout_cost(layout, lengths, domains, sp_size=1, padding_alignment=None, capacity=None):
+    costs = []
+    start = 0
+    for samples, cp_size in _groups(layout):
+        local_lengths = [_local_length(lengths[sid], cp_size, sp_size) for sid in samples]
+        compute = sum(length**2 * cp_size for length in local_lengths)
+        crosses = len(set(domains[start : start + cp_size])) > 1
+        tokens = _dcp_communication_tokens(sum(local_lengths), capacity, padding_alignment)
+        extra = _dcp_communication_overhead(compute, tokens, cp_size, crosses, _COST)
+        costs.extend([compute + extra] * cp_size)
+        start += cp_size
+    return costs

+class _ReplayIterator:
+    def __init__(self, items):
+        self.iterable = iter(items)
+        self.replaying = False
+        self.saved = []
+        self.position = 0
+
+    def __next__(self):
+        if self.replaying:
+            result = self.saved[self.position]
+            self.position += 1
+            return result
+        result = next(self.iterable)
+        self.saved.append(result)
+        return result
+

+    assert model.metadata()["modeled_transport"] == "U8 all-to-all + ring"
+    assert "not a Qwen calibration" in model.metadata()["shape"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cp", [8, 16, 32])
+def test_full_stack_is_counted_once_and_global_constant_once(cp):
+    geometry = _geometry(cp)
+    model = USPCalibV1CostModel(geometry, allow_provisional=True)
+    lengths = (7001, 1025)
+    parts = model.components(lengths, cp)
+    total = sum(parts[name] for name in ("compute_ms", "a2a_ms", "ring_ms"))
+    assert model.layer_count * (model.forward(lengths, cp) + model.backward(lengths, cp)) == (
+        pytest.approx(total, rel=1e-14)
+    )
+    program = model.program_costs(lengths, cp)
+    timeline = build_timeline(model, geometry)
+    groups = [(0, cp, model.forward(lengths, cp), model.backward(lengths, cp), program)]
+    assert timeline.evaluate([groups]) == pytest.approx(total + 2000, rel=1e-13)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("lengths,cp", [((1,), 24), ((1,), 4), ((0,), 8), ((), 8), ((True,), 8)])
+def test_invalid_model_queries_do_not_silently_extrapolate(lengths, cp):
+    model = USPCalibV1CostModel(_geometry(), allow_provisional=True)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        model.forward(lengths, cp)
+
+
+def test_persistent_worker_uses_proxy_without_importing_upstream_or_cuda():
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank=1024,
+        min_dynamic_context_parallel_size=8,
+        dynamic_cp_runtime_model="usp_calib_v1",
+        dynamic_cp_runtime_model_options='{"allow_provisional":true}',
+        dynamic_cp_runtime_solver="dynamic_usp",
+    )
+    spec = prefetch.runtime_spec(config, 32)
+    lengths, padded, baseline = [7200, 7300, 15000], [7232, 7360, 15040], [[[0, 1, 2]] * 32]
+    worker = prefetch._CpuPlanner(spec)
+    try:
+        first = worker.solve(lengths, padded, baseline)
+        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor:
+            second = executor.submit(worker.solve, lengths, padded, baseline).result(timeout=30)
+    finally:
+        worker.close()
+    assert first["rows"] == second["rows"]
+    assert first["predicted_ms"] == second["predicted_ms"]
+    assert first["worker_pid"] == second["worker_pid"]
+    for result in (first, second):
+        assert result["statistics"]["group_sizes"] == [8, 16, 32]
+        assert not result["worker_cuda_initialized"]
+        assert not result["worker_distributed_initialized"]
+        assert not result["external_scheduler_imported"]
+        assert result["model_metadata"]["name"] == "usp_calib_v1"
+
+
+def test_cpu_only_guard_also_covers_model_metadata(monkeypatch):
+    state = {"cuda": False}
+
+    def metadata():
+        state["cuda"] = True
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "is_initialized", lambda: state["cuda"])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "is_initialized", lambda: False)
+    planner = SimpleNamespace(geometry=_geometry(8), model=SimpleNamespace(metadata=metadata))
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="must not initialize CUDA"):
+        dcp_runtime_worker._solve(planner, {"force_powers": True}, [64], [64], [[[0]] * 8])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "case", json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("dcp_usp_frozen_costs.json").read_text())["cases"]
+)
+def test_default_profile_matches_frozen_upstream_group_costs(case):
+    model = USPCalibV1CostModel(_geometry(), allow_provisional=True)
+    parts = model.components(tuple(case["lengths"]), case["cp"])
+    for name in ("compute_ms", "a2a_ms", "ring_ms"):
+        assert parts[name] == pytest.approx(case[name], rel=2e-15, abs=1e-12)
